Eight in 10 parents are longing for holidays’ past (81%), according to new research.

Two surveys, each of 2,000 parents of children ages 5 to 17, explored the nostalgia parents feel for their own childhood celebrations — and how they’re trying to preserve that same sense of magic for their children today.

Those polled often or always wish they could go back and experience the way the holidays felt when they were kids.

If they could turn back the clock, the ’90s may be the place to go: Nearly a third of parents (31%) say the decade had the best holiday celebrations, more than any other decade.

Commissioned by Club Wyndham, a vacation club that encourages connection and together time, and conducted by Talker Research, one of the surveys found that 93% of parents regularly or occasionally recreate elements of the holidays they experienced as children for their own families.

“There’s something about the holidays that brings you right back to being a kid — the traditions, the movies, the food and all those little rituals you looked forward to every year,” said Annie Roberts, senior vice president of Club and Owner Services at Club Wyndham.

“What’s especially meaningful is seeing parents bring those traditions into their own homes while creating new ones with their kids. That mix of celebrating nostalgia and making new shared memories is really what the holidays are all about.”

Family traditions and rituals are what parents miss most about the holidays growing up (44%), followed by home-cooked family recipes (39%) and uninterrupted time together as a family (34%).

Parents are also nostalgic for the holiday movies and specials everyone watched together (32%), the surprise of not knowing what gifts they’d receive (30%), how homes were decorated (29%) and playing games or doing activities together (28%).

That desire to hold onto holiday magic may feel particularly meaningful as parents watch their own children grow up.

Parents believe age 6 is the most magical time to experience the holidays as a child, with that sense of magic beginning to taper around age 11.

Despite that, 89% are hopeful that their child is at an age where they still find meaning in celebrating big moments together.

Similarly, 85% of parents believe the holiday spirit is alive and well in their child, especially during the holiday season — including three-quarters of parents of teens (78%).

More than four in 10 (44%) said they’re trying to be more present as they think about how many holiday seasons they have left while their children are still young.

Thinking about past celebrations, 83% admit they haven’t been fully present for most of those moments.

And nearly three-quarters (74%) believe it’s harder for families to be engaged with one another during the holidays today compared to when they were kids.

Parents are also looking to travel as a way to mark meaningful moments together, with holidays (89%), birthdays (80%), and life milestones (79%) marking the occasions they want to celebrate through a trip.

Among those who have traveled for these big moments, 87% said time away together has been key to creating memories, while 89% plan to continue doing so as everyone gets older.

This year, respondents are looking for more opportunities to get away together, including birthdays (39%), winter holidays (35%), family reunions (32%), the Fourth of July (30%) and spring break (28%).

“Vacations give families the chance to step away from everyday distractions and focus on being together,” Roberts said. “We see that same idea come to life in our holiday experiences, where familiar traditions and nostalgic touches can spark memories for parents while giving families a chance to create entirely new ones together.”

Talker Research ran two surveys, each with a sample of 2,000 parents of school-aged children who celebrate occasions and have gone on vacation together in the past year who have access to the internet; the surveys were commissioned by Club Wyndham. The first was administered and conducted online by Talker Research conducted between June 3 and June 12, 2026, and the second between Sept. 23 and Sept. 30, 2026.
news.content:
پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. طبق تحقیقات جدید، از هر 10 والدین هشت نفر در حسرت گذشته تعطیلات هستند (81%). دو نظرسنجی، هر یک از 2000 والدین کودکان 5 تا 17 ساله، حس نوستالژی والدین برای جشن های دوران کودکی خود را بررسی کردند - و اینکه چگونه تلاش می کنند همان حس جادویی را برای فرزندان خود حفظ کنند. کسانی که اغلب یا همیشه در نظرسنجی شرکت می‌کنند آرزو می‌کنند که بتوانند به عقب برگردند و حس تعطیلات را در دوران کودکی تجربه کنند. اگر می‌توانستند ساعت را به عقب برگردانند، دهه 90 ممکن است جایی برای رفتن باشد: تقریباً یک سوم والدین (31٪) می‌گویند این دهه بهترین جشن‌های تعطیلات را داشت، بیش از هر دهه دیگری. یکی از تحقیقات انجام شده توسط کلاب ویندهام، یک باشگاه تعطیلات که ارتباط و زمان با هم را تشویق می‌کند، انجام شد، یکی از نظرسنجی‌ها نشان داد که 93 درصد از والدین به طور منظم یا گهگاهی عناصر تعطیلاتی را که در کودکی تجربه کرده‌اند، برای خانواده‌های خود بازسازی می‌کنند. آنی رابرتز، معاون ارشد کلوپ و خدمات مالک در کلاب ویندهام، گفت: «چیزی در مورد تعطیلات وجود دارد که شما را به کودکی بازمی‌گرداند - سنت‌ها، فیلم‌ها، غذاها و همه آن آیین‌های کوچکی که هر سال منتظر آن بودید. این ترکیبی از جشن گرفتن نوستالژی و ساختن خاطرات مشترک جدید واقعاً چیزی است که تعطیلات به آن مربوط می شود."

A Canadian former mommy blogger who was a married straight woman before becoming a transgender man just added yet another label to themselves — “two-spirit.”

Rowan Jette Knox — who previously described themselves as a “straight mother and wife,” “bisexual,” “pansexual,” “disabled AUDHD non-binary queer person,” “polyamorous lover to three trans-identified men” and “trans guy,” according to Quillette — announced the latest gender evolution in September.

Two-spirited is a term used by indigenous communities to describe people who have a masculine and feminine spirit.

Knox — who was previously married for around 30 years to a man named Mark, who also eventually transitioned and became “Zoe” — revealed they want to reconnect to what they described as their “lost culture.

“I finally felt ready to claim the two-spirit identity for myself,” wrote Knox, a co-owner of a Toronto coffee shop who dropped the news three years after coming out as a transgender man, on Threads.

“It’s a big step for me at 50 years old. I’ve been actively connecting with my lost culture (my Indigenous father left when I was a baby – intergenerational trauma played a big part), learning the stories, reading the history, and giving myself permission to belong,” said the author — a parent of four who was named one of 2020’s Most Influential Parents by the magazine Today’s Parent.

“So hello, my name is Rowan, and I am trans and two-spirit,” Knox said, before using an Indigenous greeting that translates as, “I am happy to see you.”

Knox, who previously lived as Amanda Knox, blamed the effects of colonialism for the delay in reconnecting with their heritage.

“It’s not my fault I didn’t grow up within my culture (I firmly blame colonialism and the intergenerational trauma it caused in my family) but it is my responsibility to lean in and learn the teachings now,” the author wrote.

“I wish I had done it sooner, but it’s never too late.”

Knox, a parent of four who was named one of 2020’s Most Influential Parents by the magazine Today’s Parent, announced that that they are two-spirited a year after undergoing a double mastectomy.

The milestone surgery came two years after announcing they would be transitioning.

“I’ve known this is who I am for a long time, but I had to work up the courage to say it out loud,” Knox wrote on X in 2023, according to Pink News.

“It took months of introspection, therapy, long chats with loved ones, plenty of tears and pushing through a lot of fear and denial to get here but am glad I’m here.”

Knox admitted “not living authentically” was a “heavy load to carry” – but said they now “[get] to live as Rowan forever.

“I don’t exactly know how that’s going to feel, but I can only imagine it will be a whole lot better than how I’ve been feeling up until now,” the author added.

Knox said they chose the name Rowan because “the rowan tree is known for its strength and protection in stories and legends around the world,” the Toronto Star reported.

Knox was married for around 30 years to hubby Mark before Mark also transitioned and became Zoe.

They separated but lived with their transgender partners in a four-person household but appear to have gone their separate ways as two couples. Knox now lives with Dani.

Things are getting hairy for Bigfoot in New Jersey!

A group of hunters is investigating Sasquatch “sightings” in the Garden State — where the mysterious upright-walking beast has reportedly been seen or heard nearly 80 times.

Though legend has it Sasquatch lives in the Pacific Northwest, The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has listed 79 reported Bigfoot sightings in New Jersey on its website.

Bigfoot researcher Mike Familant and his team recently honed in on an unexplainably eerie, animal-like sound after mimicking an owl at High Point State Park in northwestern Jersey, Familant told NJ.com

The group recorded the sound in 2022 — but the mystery deepened when an expert determined it had come from outside of the area’s known animal world, said Familant, who documents the sightings on his online series, “In the Shadow of Big Red Eye.”

A military linguist “came back with a report that said it was outside of human vocal range and wasn’t any known animal from northwestern New Jersey,” Familant said.

The forests of Delaware Water Gap and Stokes State Forest are also supposed hotspots for the elusive ape, according to Familant.

Jacob Korbel, an investigator for the research organization, said he was at first a Bigfoot skeptic — until he joined the group on an outing in the Pine Barrens in 2021.

“About 100 yards away in front of us, there’s this whoop response,” Korbel told NJ.com. “And right away, I’m like, that’s nothing that I’ve ever heard before. That’s not an owl, that’s not a coyote, fox.”

“And you could hear it slowly getting closer to our position, like it was coming in to check us out. Like we were almost getting flanked,” he recalled.

Overall, the reported Bigfoot sightings include 18 in Sussex County, 16 in Burlington County and 11 in Ocean County.

Despite their research, there is still no irrefutable evidence Bigfoot exists, is elusive or just mythical.

True believers point to everything from footprints to photographs and even DNA from hair as evidence the beast has been stomping around the forests of North America for decades.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

U2 is readying their passports.

The Rock Hall of Famers recently announced they’re going to play huge venues all over the globe on their 2027 The Greatest Show on Earth World Tour.

Notable locales on the international run — where they’ll be joined by special guests Wolf Alice and Beck on select dates — include Amsterdam, London, Berlin Mexico City and São Paulo among others.

If you’d like to be at “The Greatest Show on Earth,” tickets are officially available for some of the overseas concerts as of today.

At the time of publication, the lowest price we could find on seats for any one show was $131 USD including fees on StubHub.

Other concerts have prices starting anywhere from $134 to $951 including fees.

All gigs come in support of the group’s forthcoming 16th studio album “Carnaval de Luz,” which hits shelves on Nov. 13.

“We…decided…the album should be a countervailing mood to the times,” The Edge told The New York Times. “People are really a bit lost, and we were like, ‘what is it that we can help with here?’ And we thought an album that’s a party, a celebration, a sort of bringing people together, a gathering around our common aspirations, would be the thing to do.”

Ahead of the record’s release, they have released three upbeat singles: “Street of Dreams,” “Silencio” and “The Greatest Show On Earth,” which shares a name with the tour.

Prior to the outing, U2 will perform at the NFL’s first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game. They’ll handle halftime show duties in the Wednesday, Nov. 25 contest between the Green Bay Packers and Los Angeles Rams.

As of now, there’s no word yet on whether or not they’ll be a North American leg of the tour. Keep your eyes peeled though, U2ers. An announcement could come any “Beautiful Day” now.

For more information, our team has everything you need to know and more about U2’s 2027 The Greatest Show on Earth World Tour below.

A calendar that includes all upcoming U2 concert dates with tickets available (and their prices in USD) are listed here:

*Editor’s Note: Tickets haven’t gone on sale for shows in Sweden, France, Portugal, Italy and other countries yet.

The Irish rockers headlined at The Sphere on Dec. 16, 2023. Here’s what they played that night, courtesy of Set List FM:

01.) “Zoo Station”02.) “The Fly”03.) “Even Better Than the Real Thing”04.) “Mysterious Ways”05.) “One”06.) “Until the End of the World”07.) “Who’s Gonna Ride Your Wild Horses”08.) “Tryin’ to Throw Your Arms Around the World”Turntable

09.) “All I Want Is You”10.) “Desire”11.) “Angel of Harlem”12.) “Love Rescue Me”Achtung Baby

13.) “Acrobat”14.) “So Cruel”15.) “Ultraviolet (Light My Way)”16.) “Love Is Blindness”

17.) “Elevation”18.) “Atomic City”19.) “Vertigo”20.) “Where the Streets Have No Name”21.) “With or Without You”22.) “Beautiful Day”

Before the release of “Carnaval de Luz,” U2 has released a trio of singles.

Up first is the fist-pumping anthem “Street Of Dreams,” which features an auto-tuned, angelic-sounding Bono until the song hits a more familiar register, marrying The Edge’s trademark strummy, measured guitar with Bono’s impassioned vocals. For our money, it’s a powerful rallying cry that also happens to be a burst of joy.

“Silencio” is a bit more of a straightforward rocker with a punk streak running throughout. Tempo changes from hard-charging to slowed-down quieter moments will keep you on your toes wondering where U2 is going until the party-like chorus erupts. WARNING: you’ll be singing this one in the shower for months.

That famous U2 sound — where the six-string sounds like the pitter-patter of rain — permeates throughout the gorgeous “The Greatest Show On Earth.” By far the longest track of the three singles, it’s a showstopper that builds tension until giving listeners a sweet release via Bono’s joyful yelps.

U2 has been tearing up the charts since before “Video Killed The Radio Star” played on MTV.

They’re not alone, though. Here are just five of our favorite contemporaries of theirs on the road that you won’t have to travel overseas for this year and next.

• Def Leppard with Goo Goo Dolls

• Bachman-Turner Overdrive

Plus, The Eagles are at Sphere from November through January. Don’t miss seeing the legendary ensemble live.

This article was written by Matt Levy, New York Post live events reporter. Levy stays up-to-date on all the latest tour announcements from your favorite musical artists and comedians, as well as Broadway openings, sporting events and more live shows – and finds great ticket prices online. Since he started his tenure at the Post in 2022, Levy has reviewed a Bruce Springsteen concert and interviewed Melissa Villaseñor of SNL fame, to name a few. Child pornography has allegedly been found in a storage unit rented by Thomas Markle, near his former home in Mexico.

The Daily Mail made the alleged discovery and subsequently reported Meghan Markle’s estranged father to the FBI.

Reporters from the publication traveled to Rosarito Beach, Mexico, and found Thomas’ abandoned storage unit. They allegedly found magazines published in Asia depicting child pornography, among family mementoes, photographs and letters.

Amongst the alleged disturbing findings were books about pedophilia and magazines showing children being sexually abused, as well as several loose photographs of naked Asian females.

The Daily Mail claims some of the women looked conspicuously young.

The outlet also allegedly uncovered 35mm negatives showing apparently random images of children on a beach.

Other negatives show a woman with her limbs bound or “hogtied” and being directed by a man during a photo shoot.

Page Six has reached out to the FBI but did not receive a response at the time of publishing.

The alleged discovery was made a week after news surfaced of Thomas being investigated for “hundreds if not thousands” of child porn images.

The retired director of photography has vehemently denied all accusations against him.

His son, Thomas Jr., reported his father to local officials last week after he allegedly found child porn materials inside several boxes at his Phillipines home.

Thomas Jr. told the Sun, “When I found this material I was horrified and I had no option but to report my dad.”

Thomas Jr. reportedly told pals he found a 15-minute video of unclothed girls on an abandoned LG mobile phone and was left “shocked and disgusted.”

news.content: موارد بیشتری از پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. هشدار: این مقاله حاوی جزئیات محتوای گرافیکی است. ظاهراً هرزه‌نگاری کودکان در یک واحد ذخیره‌سازی اجاره‌ای توسط توماس مارکل، در نزدیکی خانه سابقش در مکزیک پیدا شده است. دیلی میل این کشف ادعایی را انجام داد و متعاقباً پدر مگان را به اطلاع عموم رساند. به ساحل روزاریتو، مکزیک سفر کرد و واحد ذخیره سازی متروک توماس را پیدا کرد. آنها ظاهراً مجلات منتشر شده در آسیا را پیدا کردند که پورنوگرافی کودکان را به تصویر می‌کشد، در میان یادگاری‌های خانوادگی، عکس‌ها و نامه‌ها. در میان یافته‌های نگران‌کننده ادعایی، کتاب‌هایی در مورد پدوفیلی و مجلاتی بود که کودکان را نشان می‌دادند که مورد آزار جنسی قرار می‌گرفتند، و همچنین چندین عکس آزاد از زنان برهنه آسیایی. دیلی میل ادعا می‌کند که برخی از زنان جوان به نظر می‌رسند که از این زنان جوان به نظر می‌رسند. ظاهراً این رسانه همچنین نگاتیوهای 35 میلی‌متری را کشف کرده است که تصاویر ظاهراً تصادفی از کودکان را در ساحل نشان می‌دهد. سایر نگاتیوها زنی را نشان می‌دهند که اندام‌هایش را بسته یا "گرم کرده" نشان می‌دهد و توسط مردی در طول عکاسی هدایت می‌شود. صفحه شش به FBI مراجعه کرده است اما در زمان انتشار پاسخی دریافت نکرده است. این کشف ادعایی یک هفته پس از انتشار اخباری مبنی بر تحقیقات توماس به دلیل "صدها و نه هزاران" تصویر پورنو کودک انجام شد. مدیر بازنشسته عکاسی به شدت تمام اتهامات علیه خود را رد کرده است. پسرش، توماس جونیور، هفته گذشته پس از اینکه ادعا می‌شود که او مطالب پورن کودک را پیدا کرده بود، به مقامات محلی گزارش داد.

It’s the standard routine at boutique studios and fitness centers nationwide: the class wraps up, the music fades, and attendees are handed a single disinfectant wipe to frantically scrub down their machines for the next gym-goer.

Now, a viral complaint has ignited fierce debate over who should actually be responsible for cleaning gym gear — the paying member or the business itself.

In a video posted to social media, beauty expert Nikol Johnson Sanchez has called out the fitness industry for turning high-end reformer Pilates and boutique studios into a “self-service cleaning arrangement.”

“When did a luxury Pilates class become a self-service cleaning arrangement?” Sanchez asked in an Instagram clip.

“We have the lighting is beautiful, the branding is impeccable, and the price is a premium … and then the class ends, and you’re handed this tiny little square of a wipe to prepare the machine for the next paying client.”

She argued patrons wouldn’t be expected to bus their own plates or wash cutlery at an expensive restaurant, nor sweep up hair after a salon haircut.

“Why is the cleanliness of an expensive studio dependent on how thoroughly the woman before me felt like wiping?” Sanchez said, noting that shared props like reformer straps and Pilates balls placed under sweaty heads and between thighs rarely get properly disinfected.

“A courtesy wipe from a client shouldn’t be a cleaning standard,” she argued.

Industry experts admit the complaint hits uncomfortably close to home.

Simon Ngo, Creative Director and Director of Pilates & Yoga at Flow Athletic, agreed that leaving cleaning entirely to patrons undermines high-end fitness brands.

“She has a valid point that how come everything part of the boutique experience process is so thought out until the cleaning and transitions between classes,” Ngo told news.com.au.

“So on this point I agree that it’s the one percent let-down, especially when it’s a luxe and boutique experience.

“Because absolutely those straps are a ‘don’t ask, don’t tell, don’t look, don’t acknowledge’ kinda vibe, though I’m sure most businesses do put them through deep wash and sanitization periodically.”

Ngo noted that while wiping down gear is good etiquette, studios cutting corners on cleaning supplies only worsens the problem.

“It’s just good etiquette too to clean up after yourselves,” he shared.

“Especially educating the users to put away weights and equipment nicely and where they belong. This is culture building.

“I get it that those disinfecting wipes can add up in terms of cost, but a ‘singular square’ is absolutely way too stingy and insufficient. Let people have two or three.”

Ngo added that the “one percent” can “make or break” the experience for a gym-goer.

Beyond client convenience, medical experts warn that lax turnover cleaning presents genuine health and hygiene risks.

Dr. Shreya Andric, Principal Dermatologist and co-director at North Sydney Dermatology, warned that fitness equipment provides prime conditions for spreading communicable skin conditions.

“Gym equipment is high-touch surfaces, with multiple people using the same machines, weights and mats throughout the day,” Andric told news.com.au.

“Bacteria, fungi and viruses can be transferred onto these surfaces, potentially spreading skin infections such as folliculitis, staph infections and ringworm.”

Dr. Andric stressed that studios cannot simply rely on a quick morning clean or assume every client cleans effectively.

“Cleaning equipment just once a day isn’t sufficient, as surfaces can become contaminated again with each use,” she said.

“Regular cleaning and disinfection throughout the day, alongside encouraging gym users to wipe down equipment after use, is important to minimize the risk of infection.”

پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. این روال استاندارد در استودیوهای بوتیک و مراکز تناسب اندام در سراسر کشور است: کلاس به پایان می رسد، موسیقی محو می شود و شرکت کنندگان یک دستمال ضدعفونی کننده به دست می آورند تا دستگاه های خود را برای ورزشکار بعدی تمیز کنند. اکنون، شکایت ویروسی در واقع مسئول پاکسازی بدن است. عضو پرداخت کننده یا خود کسب و کار نیکول جانسون سانچز، متخصص زیبایی، در ویدئویی که در رسانه‌های اجتماعی منتشر شده است، صنعت تناسب اندام را به دلیل تبدیل پیلاتس و استودیوهای بوتیک پیشرفته به یک «تجهیزات نظافتی سلف‌سرویس» دعوت کرده است.
"چه زمانی یک کلاس پیلاتس لوکس به یک ترتیب تمیز کردن سلف سرویس تبدیل شد؟" سانچز در یک کلیپ اینستاگرامی پرسید. "ما داریم که نورپردازی زیبا است، نام تجاری بی عیب و نقص است، و قیمت فوق العاده است ... و سپس کلاس به پایان می رسد، و این مربع کوچک دستمال مرطوب را به شما می دهند تا دستگاه را برای مشتری بعدی آماده کنید."
او استدلال می‌کرد که از مشتریان انتظار نمی‌رود که بشقاب‌های خود را با اتوبوس یا کارد و چنگال را در یک رستوران گران‌قیمت بشویند، یا بعد از کوتاه کردن موی سالن، موها را جارو کنند. "چرا تمیزی یک استودیوی گران قیمت به این بستگی دارد که زن قبل از من چقدر دوست دارد پاک کند؟" سانچز گفت و خاطرنشان کرد که وسایل مشترک مانند تسمه های اصلاح کننده و توپ های پیلاتس که زیر سرهای عرق کرده و بین ران ها قرار می گیرند به ندرت به درستی ضد عفونی می شوند. گزارش صبح آخرین اخبار، فیلم ها، عکس ها و موارد دیگر را ارائه می دهد. لطفاً یک ایمیل معتبر ارائه دهید.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A grandma accused of murdering her transgender New York Times executive son-in-law is throwing her husband under the bus in a bombshell bail filing, making shocking claims about her co-defendant in a bid for freedom.

Lawyers for Shili Chen, 77, claim her husband, Shouyong Zhang, was “fixated” on Jonathan McKinsey, the executive married to their daughter, Candice Jang, and was the one who fatally shot him in September.

Chen’s attorney, Curtis Briggs, writes that Chen did not fire the first shots at McKinsey when the couple allegedly gunned him down in the parking lot of Dublin Sports Grounds.

Briggs says Chen watched as her husband, 77-year-old Shouyong Zhang, fired the deadly shots at McKinsey before she got out of the car “to protect her husband from what she feared was an assault by Mr. McKinsey.”

Chen then “walked towards his body and fired several shots into his motionless body as her husband appeared to be doubled over with pain clutching his abdomen,” Briggs wrote.

The couple went to the park only at her husband’s direction, Briggs wrote, and only knew that Zhang instructed her to bring a gun “for the purported purposes of going to the shooting range.”

Briggs also presents evidence that Zhang was “consumed by the belief” McKinsey, whom he told police had a “dark soul,” would kill him. He became increasingly obsessed with him and believed the executive set up two instances in which he was hit by cars while riding his bike in the preceding months.

He thought McKinsey targeted him because he would have “freedom” without the grandfather present.

“I truly do believe the reason he wants to set me up and harm/kill me because without me, he will have full freedom,” Zhang told police, also admitting that he killed McKinsey to protect himself and his grandchildren from future harm.

Police executed a search warrant at the couple’s one-bedroom apartment and made a shocking finding that convinced them “Zhang had formed an intent to target McKinsey.”

In the couple’s bedroom, Briggs wrote, police found four photo albums, nitrile gloves, and an empty box for a Sig Sauer pistol. The gloves matched those found at the scene from Chen, while the photo albums held a chilling twist.

Several photos of McKinsey “had portions of his face cut out, and that one had black marks and dots drawn on his chest and over his right eye in places that appeared consistent with where he was later shot,” Briggs detailed.

It’s unclear who marked the photographs, but Briggs suggested a detective at the scene used them to form conclusions about Zhang’s motivations before the murder.

Chen’s defense team did note Zhang appeared to show “significant signs of advanced dementia” in the lead-up to the alleged murder.

Briggs says Chen should be released because of her poor health — which includes high blood pressure and blood sugar issues. He’s also particularly concerned about Santa Rita Jail she is held in. 5 people have reportedly died since the beginning of this year at the jail.

“For Ms. Chen, detention before trial may become a death sentence without a conviction,” Briggs wrote.

He added that Briggs would be a minimal flight risk because she does not have the means to flee, and he offered to have her under home detention with GPS monitoring. Briggs wanted Chen to take residence with her daughter, Candice Jang, who was going through a contentious divorce and custody proceedings with McKinsey before the murder.

He also argued against the lying-in-wait special circumstance, saying if the prosecution argued Chen is the actual killer, it would “be a strain on the facts” because Zhang “fired so many shots into Mr. McKinsey’s chest and head before Ms. Chen arrived.”

Chen’s bail hearing is set for Nov. 4.
news.content:
پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. مادربزرگ متهم به قتل داماد اجرایی تراجنسیتی خود در نیویورک تایمز، شوهرش را در یک پرونده وثیقه بمب به زیر اتوبوس می‌اندازد و در تلاش برای آزادی، ادعاهای تکان‌دهنده‌ای درباره هم‌متهم خود دارد. وکلای شیلی چن، 77 ساله، ادعا می کنند که شوهرش، شویونگ ژانگ، با جاناتان مک کینزی، مدیر اجرایی ازدواج با دخترشان، کندیس جانگ، "مجاز" شده بود و کسی بود که او را در ماه سپتامبر به ضرب گلوله کشت. کورتیس بریگز، وکیل چن، می نویسد که چن اولین شلیک گلوله را انجام نداده است. زمین های ورزشی دوبلین بریگز می‌گوید که چن شاهد بود که شوهرش، شویونگ ژانگ، ۷۷ ساله، قبل از پیاده شدن از ماشین، به سمت مک‌کینزی تیراندازی مرگبار شلیک می‌کرد تا از شوهرش در برابر آنچه می‌ترسید از حمله آقای مک‌کینزی محافظت کند.
بریگز نوشت: چن سپس «به سمت بدن او رفت و چندین گلوله به بدن بی‌حرکت او شلیک کرد، زیرا به نظر می‌رسید شوهرش با درد در شکمش دو برابر شده بود». بریگز نوشت، این زوج فقط به دستور شوهرش به پارک رفتند و فقط می‌دانستند که ژانگ به او دستور داده است که یک اسلحه بیاورد «برای اهداف ظاهراً رفتن به میدان تیر».
بریگز همچنین شواهدی ارائه می‌کند که نشان می‌دهد ژانگ «با این باور که مک‌کینزی»، که به پلیس گفته بود «روح تاریکی» دارد، «محور شده بود» او را می‌کشد. او به طور فزاینده ای نسبت به او وسواس پیدا کرد و معتقد بود که مدیر اجرایی دو مورد را ترتیب داده است که در آن هنگام سوار شدن به سلام با ماشین ها برخورد می کند.

news.originalContent:
کریستا پایک، زندانی زن محکوم به اعدام در ایالت تنسی آمریکا که بیش از یک ماه پیش، از تزریق دو دوز داروی کشنده جان سالم به در برد، اولین بیانیه عمومی خود را منتشر کرده است.

او در این بیانیه گفته است که از آن زمان، حتی یک لحظه هم نبوده که درد جسمانی یا روحی نکشیده باشد.

خانم پایک پس از ناکامی مقام‌های زندان در اجرای حکم اعدامش، به بیمارستان منتقل و بعداً مرخص شد. در جریان تلاش برای اجرای حکم، دو دوز از داروی پنتوباربیتال به او تزریق شده بود، اما او زنده ماند.

خانم پایک روز جمعه در بیانیه‌ای که اعضای تیم حقوقی او در شبکه‌های اجتماعی منتشر کردند، گفت بدنش، بازوهایش، دست‌هایش و گلویش درد می‌کند و به‌سختی می‌تواند صحبت کند.

پرونده او و روند اجرای حکم اعدامش باعث انتقاد شدید طرفداران و مخالفان مجازات اعدام شد.

کریستا پایک از سی سال قبل به دلیل قتل و شکنجه کالین اسلمر، یکی از همکلاسی‌هایش، در انتظار اجرای حکم اعدام بوده است.

هنوز مشخص نیست که آیا ایالت تنسی آمریکا قصد دارد در آینده حکم اعدام او را اجرا کند یا نه.

خانم پایک حالا پنجاه ساله است و به همان زندانی بازگردانده شده که طی سی سال اخیر در آن حبس بوده است.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

گمان می‌رود او تنها فردی باشد که از تلاش برای اعدام از طریق تزریق داروی کشنده جان به در برده است.

پیش‌تر، وکلای خانم پایک گفته بودند که او پس از آنکه از تلاش برای اعدام جان به در برد، به ذات‌الریه مبتلا شده، بازوهایش به‌شدت ورم کرده و توانایی بلعیدن را نیز از دست داده است.

او در بیانیه‌اش گفته است: «در حال بهبودی هستم و می‌دانم که روزبه‌روز قوی‌تر می‌شوم؛ اما بهبودی به معنای آن نیست که خوبم.»

خانم پایک در سال ۱۹۹۶ به جرم قتل کالین اسلمر، زن ۱۹ ساله‌ای که یک سال پیش‌تر کشته شده بود، به اعدام محکوم شد. او هنگام ارتکاب قتل ۱۸ سال داشت.

اجرای حکم کریستا پایک تا آخرین ساعات با کشمکش حقوقی همراه بود. دادگاه تجدیدنظر حوزه ششم آمریکا حدود یک ساعت پیش از زمان تعیین‌شده، اجرای حکم را متوقف کرد، اما چند ساعت بعد دیوان عالی ایالات متحده این توقف را لغو کرد و راه برای اجرای حکم باز شد.

بر اساس اسناد پرونده، خانم پایک و دوست‌پسرش در آن زمان، تاداریل شیپ، در سال ۱۹۹۵ کالین اسلمر را که در یک مرکز آموزش شغلی در ناکسویل با او آشنا شده بودند، مورد ضرب‌وشتم قرار دادند و او را کشتند.

می مارتینز، مادر مقتول، از جمله کسانی بود که خواهان اجرای حکم اعدام کریستا پایک بوده است.

این دومین بار در سال جاری میلادی بود که ایالت تنسی نتوانست یک حکم اعدام را اجرا کند. در ماه مه هم اجرای حکم تونی کاروترز پس از آن متوقف شد که مأموران نتوانستند مسیر وریدی برای تزریق پیدا کنند.

پس از آنکه روند اجرای حکم اعدام خانم پایک با مشکل مواجه شد، وکلای او درخواست فوری برای توقف اعدام و ارائه مراقبت‌های پزشکی ثبت کردند.

news.originalContent:
(Source: YouTube, O’Keefe Media Group)

The Justice Department is reviewing the felony charges against journalists James O’Keefe and Cam Higby over their undercover election sting in Minnesota.

O’Keefe and Higby were charged Wednesday with felony unlawful voting by Minnesota prosecutors. Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty also announced the state was charging both men with identity theft. (RELATED: Minnesota Prosecutor Slaps James O’Keefe, Cam Higby With Felony Charges After They Expose Election Security Loopholes)

When asked whether the Department of Justice (DOJ) would review the state-level prosecution for potential retaliation against constitutionally protected investigative journalism, a DOJ spokesperson told the Daily Caller the department was ‘concerned’ about ‘intimidation’ related to First Amendment activity.

Minnesota charged me with two felonies over this investigation. The prosecutor says it’s "pretty clear" we didn’t intend to vote. So judge for yourself. The whole thing, start to finish ↓ https://t.co/pPvqOxU53y

“We are aware of the county prosecutor’s charges and are reviewing the police report, video, and other available material. We are of course concerned about intimidation related to First Amendment activity,” the spokesperson wrote.

The spokesperson added that the department could not comment further.

In August, O’Keefe released a video showing himself and Higby entering Minneapolis polling locations during the state’s primary election while wearing Islamic garb and using hidden cameras to record their interactions.

Prosecutors allege O’Keefe and Higby violated a state law prohibiting individuals from attempting to obtain a ballot by impersonating a registered voter.

The felony charges carry potential prison sentences of up to five years. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: ICE Reveals Fresh Lineup Of Foreign Nationals Accused Of Voter Fraud)

During the undercover operation, O’Keefe allegedly used fake accents when speaking with poll workers, while he and Higby made references to Muslim culture. Higby also wore black clothing that concealed his face and head.

At a Wednesday news conference, Moriarty, a prosecutor elected in 2022, said the charges were not motivated by the pair’s political views or by whether their behavior and disguises were perceived as offensive or derogatory.

James Edward O’Keefe, 42, and Cam Higby, 26, both face felony charges of unlawful voting and identity theft. Polling places are the heart of our democracy. Any attempt to disrupt or deceive our election workers will not be tolerated. Watch: https://t.co/LH1Q5m224J https://t.co/NMPizpONcN

In a Wednesday press release, Moriarty alleged O’Keefe and Higby “intentionally misrepresented their identities in applying for ballots.”

Moriarty pointed to a video O’Keefe posted that documented the interactions with poll workers. The video showed the pair discussing their intent to draw attention to Minnesota’s voter-vouching law, according to criminal complaints the Daily Caller reviewed.

Neither complaint alleges either man actually cast a ballot.

Minnesota law allows registered voters to vouch for the residency of up to eight other individuals who recently moved, allowing them to vote in precincts where they have not yet registered.

Moriarty has faced criticism over her handling of violent-crime cases, particularly her 2023 plea deals for two teenage brothers charged in the murder of Zaria McKeever. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: ICE Drops New Batch Of Illegal Immigrants Accused Of Voter Fraud Ahead Of Midterms)

The proposed deals, which included roughly two years in a juvenile correctional facility followed by probation, drew objections from McKeever’s family and Democratic Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison, who called the proposed outcomes disproportionate, according to MPR News and the Associated Press reports.

I’m not a “conservative influencer” I’m an American Journalist. I’m fighting for your 1st amendment rights to report at @NBCNews in this case, as much as I am our own.

After Moriarty declined to transfer the case, Democrat Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz invoked a rarely used authority in April 2023 to move it to Ellison’s office without her consent, prompting Moriarty to call the intervention undemocratic.

Moriarty later announced in August 2025 that she would not seek reelection, saying she wanted to focus on her remaining time in office rather than campaigning.

(منبع: YouTube، O’Keefe Media Group)
وزارت دادگستری در حال بررسی اتهامات جنایت علیه روزنامه نگاران جیمز اوکیف و کم هیگبی به دلیل حمله مخفیانه انتخاباتی آنها در مینه سوتا است. اوکیف و هیگبی روز چهارشنبه به اتهام رای دادن غیرقانونی توسط دادستان های مینه سوتا متهم شدند. مری موریارتی، دادستان شهرستان هنپین نیز اعلام کرد که ایالت هر دو مرد را به سرقت هویت متهم کرده است. (مرتبط: دادستان مینه‌سوتا به جیمز اوکیف و کم هیگبی پس از افشای خلأهای امنیتی انتخابات سیلی زد.)
هنگامی که از وزارت دادگستری پرسیده شد که آیا وزارت دادگستری (DOJ) تعقیب قضایی در سطح ایالت را برای انتقام گیری احتمالی علیه روزنامه نگاری تحقیقی مورد حمایت قانون اساسی بررسی می کند، سخنگوی وزارت دادگستری به Daily Caller گفت که این وزارت در مورد "ارعاب" مربوط به فعالیت های متمم اول "نگران" است. مینه سوتا من را به دو جنایت در این تحقیقات متهم کرد. دادستان می گوید «بسیار واضح است» که ما قصد رأی دادن نداشتیم. پس خودتان قضاوت کنید. کل کار، شروع کنید تا تمام شود ↓ https://t.co/pPvqOxU53y
سخنگوی دادگستری نوشت: "ما از اتهامات دادستان شهرستان آگاه هستیم و در حال بررسی گزارش پلیس، ویدئو، و سایر مطالب موجود هستیم. ما البته نگران ارعاب مربوط به فعالیت های متمم اول هستیم." سخنگوی وزارت امور خارجه نمی‌تواند توضیح بیشتری بدهد. در ماه آگوست، اوکیف ویدئویی منتشر کرد که نشان می‌دهد خود و هیگبی در حالی که لباس پوشیده بودند وارد محل‌های رای‌گیری مینیاپولیس می‌شوند.

news.originalContent:
Switzerland formally reopens diplomatic office in North Korea after its closure in 2020.

Switzerland has formally reopened its diplomatic office in North Korea as Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis held talks in Pyongyang about normalising political relations between the two countries.

On Friday Cassis wrapped up a two-day visit to North Korea – the first by a Swiss government minister in more than two decades – in which he discussed “regularising political relations and reestablishing a political dialogue”, he wrote on X.

Cassis, who is also Switzerland’s vice president, met Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui and Jo Yong Won, a secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Korean Workers’ Party.

“We also exchanged views on security on the Korean Peninsula and broader Eurasian security challenges,” he added on X.

After the formal reopening of the Swiss diplomatic office on Thursday, Cassis posted that he was “pleased” to mark a “new chapter” in his country’s presence in Pyongyang, hailing the office as a “concrete step towards strengthening direct dialogue” with North Korea.

The office, operational since October 19, will not have an ambassador. It reports to the Swiss embassy in Beijing, which handles diplomatic and consular relations with North Korea. The office had closed in March 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic.

“This office will help to strengthen direct contacts with the authorities of the DPRK [Democratic People’s Republic of Korea] and support political dialogue with them,” the Swiss Foreign Ministry said.

North Korea’s state news agency KCNA confirmed Cassis’s arrival in the country on Thursday but gave no details on the purpose of the visit. It had not been known beforehand whether he would meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, and there has been no report of a meeting.

Bern said it intended to maintain its commitment to the region amid heightened tensions and limited international contact with North Korea, having been one of the few Western countries to keep up a dialogue with Pyongyang.

The last Swiss Federal Council member to visit was then-Foreign Minister Micheline Calmy-Rey, in 2003.

Cassis crossed into South Korea on Friday for the final leg of his regional trip.

According to the Swiss foreign ministry, his talks in Seoul will focus on security on the peninsula, prospects for easing regional tensions and bilateral ties.

Switzerland’s involvement on the Korean Peninsula dates back more than 70 years, including its role on the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission.

Also in South Korea, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz invoked his country’s reunification during a visit to the inter-Korean border. “Let us hope that Korea, too, will one day have the chance to regain its national unity,” he said.
news.content: سوئیس پس از بسته شدن در سال 2020 دفتر دیپلماتیک خود را در کره شمالی به طور رسمی بازگشایی کرد. سوئیس دفتر دیپلماتیک خود را در کره شمالی به طور رسمی بازگشایی کرد زیرا ایگنازیو کاسیس وزیر امور خارجه در پیونگ یانگ در مورد عادی سازی روابط سیاسی بین دو کشور گفتگو کرد. او در مورد X.Cassis که معاون رئیس جمهور سوئیس نیز هست، نوشت، روز جمعه کاسیس یک سفر دو روزه به کره شمالی - اولین سفر یک وزیر دولت سوئیس در بیش از دو دهه گذشته - را به پایان رساند. وی در X می افزاید: «ما همچنین در مورد امنیت در شبه جزیره کره و چالش‌های امنیتی گسترده‌تر اوراسیا تبادل نظر کردیم.» پس از بازگشایی رسمی دفتر دیپلماتیک سوئیس در روز پنجشنبه، کاسیس پست کرد که «خوشحال» است که «فصل جدیدی» را در حضور کشورش در پیونگ‌یانگ رقم بزند، و این دفتر را به‌عنوان گامی مستقیم به سوی گفت‌وگو با کره شمالی تقویت کرد. این دفتر که از 19 اکتبر فعال است، سفیر نخواهد داشت. این گزارش به سفارت سوئیس در پکن، که روابط دیپلماتیک و کنسولی با کره شمالی را مدیریت می کند، گزارش می دهد. این دفتر در مارس 2020 در طول همه‌گیری کووید-19 بسته شده بود. «این دفتر به تقویت تماس‌های مستقیم با مقامات کره شمالی [جمهوری دموکراتیک خلق کره] و حمایت از گفت‌وگوهای سیاسی کمک می‌کند.

news.originalContent:
The decision marks a sharp reversal after the US president said he didn’t feel like he had to hold the events.

A day after announcing he would cancel a pair of campaign rallies, United States President Donald Trump has reversed course, opting to put those events back on the calendar.

A source close to the Trump administration told Al Jazeera on Friday that Trump will be headlining, in person, the previously cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa ahead of Tuesday’s midterm elections.

“Rallies are BACK ON!” the source said. “No one works harder, fights harder, or loves the American people more than President Donald J. Trump!”

Previously, Trump was due to travel to Kansas on Saturday and Iowa on Sunday. But now both rallies will take place on Sunday.

The source said the events were rearranged to include more tele-rallies, which allow Trump to attend virtually.

Republican officials have also not ruled out that an additional campaign event could be added to the president’s schedule before the midterm election.

The decision marks a sharp reversal after Trump told reporters on Thursday, “I don’t feel I have to go to Kansas.”

“We are going to have a strong ⁠Tuesday night,” Trump said of the midterms.

Iowa and Kansas are states that are normally friendly to the president’s Republican Party. Not since 1932, for instance, has Kansas elected a Democrat to a full term in the Senate.

But according to early polling data, voters in both states have trended more towards Democratic Senate candidates this campaign cycle.

In Kansas, for instance, Republican Senator Roger Marshall is in an increasingly competitive race with his Democratic challenger, megachurch pastor Adam Hamilton.

A poll from Emerson College on Friday found Hamilton in the lead, with 49 percent support compared with Marshall’s 45 percent.

Analysts have warned that Republican candidates could feel backlash at the polls over issues like the cost of living, with fuel prices higher than normal due to the US-Israel war on Iran.

Prior to Friday’s reversal, Marshall defended Trump’s decision to cancel his Kansas rally.

“They think that I’m doing so well in the polls that he’s probably got better places to spend his time,” Marshall said Thursday.

Democrats, however, were quick to accuse Trump of abandoning Republican candidates with less than four days remaining until the vote.

David Axelrod, who served as a senior adviser to former President Barack Obama, described the cancellation as a “strategic retreat” in a post on social media.

The Republican National Committee argued the virtual appearances would be more efficient, allowing Trump to reach more voters.

Trump is expected to speak at a rally in Daytona Beach, Florida, on Friday to help boost two of the state’s Republican candidates: US Senate nominee Ashley Moody and gubernatorial hopeful Byron Donalds.
news.content:
این تصمیم پس از اینکه رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده گفت که احساس نمی کند مجبور به برگزاری این رویدادها است، یک تغییر شدید است. دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده یک روز پس از اعلام لغو یک جفت گردهمایی مبارزات انتخاباتی، مسیر خود را تغییر داد و تصمیم گرفت این رویدادها را دوباره در تقویم قرار دهد. یک منبع نزدیک به دولت ترامپ روز جمعه به الجزیره گفت که ترامپ شخصاً تیتر اصلی راهپیمایی‌های لغو شده قبلی در کانزاس و آیووا در آستانه انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای روز سه‌شنبه خواهد بود. منبع گفت. هیچ کس بیشتر از رئیس جمهور دونالد جی. ترامپ سخت کار نمی کند، سخت تر نمی جنگد، یا مردم آمریکا را دوست ندارد!
پیش از این قرار بود ترامپ روز شنبه به کانزاس و یکشنبه به آیووا سفر کند. اما اکنون هر دو تظاهرات روز یکشنبه برگزار خواهند شد. این منبع گفت که رویدادها به گونه‌ای تنظیم شدند که تجمع‌های تلویزیونی بیشتری را شامل شود، که به ترامپ اجازه می‌دهد تا به صورت مجازی در آن شرکت کند. مقامات جمهوری‌خواه همچنین احتمال اضافه شدن یک رویداد تبلیغاتی اضافی به برنامه انتخاباتی رئیس‌جمهور قبل از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای را رد نکرده‌اند. این تصمیم پس از اینکه ترامپ در روز پنج‌شنبه به خبرنگاران گفت: «احساس نمی‌کنم باید به کانسا بروم»، تغییر شدیدی را نشان می‌دهد. ترامپ در مورد انتخابات میان دوره ای گفت: «ما سه شنبه شب قوی خواهیم داشت. آیووا و کانزاس ایالت هایی هستند که معمولاً با حزب جمهوری خواه رئیس جمهور دوست هستند. برای مثال، از سال 1932، کانزاس یک دموکرات را برای یک دوره کامل در سنا انتخاب نکرده است. اما طبق داده های اولیه نظرسنجی، رأی دهندگان در هر دو ایالت بیشتر به سمت سن دموکرات گرایش پیدا کرده اند.

news.originalContent:
As Houthi missiles strike Aden, residents stockpile food and prepare escape plans, fearing a return to all-out war.

For Mohammed Abdul Malik, the powerful explosions that have hit Yemen’s southern city of Aden repeatedly over the past month are an ominous warning of darker days ahead.

Yemen’s Houthis have claimed attacks against several locations in Aden, including the international airport, military camps, the city’s port, and the presidential palace – which serves as a base for Yemen’s government.

Fearing that the city could once again descend into widespread violence, Abdul Malik has begun taking precautions. He has stockpiled food and prepared his car for a long journey if he needs to leave.

“I’ll tell you about myself and my close friends: We’ve started buying and stockpiling basic provisions, like sugar and other staples,” Abdul Malik told Al Jazeera.

If the security situation deteriorates further and state institutions collapse, his Plan B is to flee Aden with his family and seek refuge in Shabwa, to the northeast, or Hadramout, to the east.

“We’ve mapped out an exit route from the city. I’ve prepared my car, checked it over, and set aside an emergency supply of fuel. I’m ready to pack up my family and head out at a moment’s notice,” he said.

After four years of relative calm, Yemen’s war has reignited in recent months, particularly since early September, when the Houthis launched a major offensive to seize government-held areas in the west of the country from the Saudi-backed, pro-government National Resistance Forces (NRF).

Within a week, the Iran-backed armed group – also known as Ansar Allah, Arabic for Supporters of God – had seized districts in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces, including the port city of Mocha, a stronghold of the NRF, and the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait.

A government counteroffensive launched in early October has made limited gains along the Red Sea coast, but at the same time the Houthis have tightened their siege of Taiz, Yemen’s third-largest city, after capturing a vital road linking it to Aden.

Aden had remained relatively peaceful despite the fierce fighting elsewhere, and had become a refuge for thousands of people displaced by the conflict.

The wave of Houthi missile and drone attacks this month has shattered that calm, and has raised fears that the Houthis may be seeking to capture Aden.

Accounts from friends who fled Taiz, where fighting and the siege have driven up prices and disrupted supplies, have deepened his concerns about what could happen to his city.

“Prices in Taiz have already doubled, and the same could easily happen in Aden. If the [Aden] port were to be struck, prices would skyrocket,” he said.

“At work, my colleagues and I talk about what we should buy, what food we ought to store, what our contingency plan is, and where we would go if we had to leave,” he added.

Abdul Malik described how the Houthi attacks have disrupted daily life in Aden, with some families limiting their movements – especially at night.

“When the [first missile] explosion occurred, one of my colleagues went to the school to pick up her son and found the students frightened and gathered together in one place. We go to work and take our children to school, but there is a sense of anxiety and tension,” he told Al Jazeera.

Aden international airport, currently Yemen’s busiest airport, has borne the brunt of the Houthi missile and drone attacks, which have repeatedly disrupted air travel, forcing airlines to cancel or delay flights and divert others to airports elsewhere in Yemen or abroad.

For residents living near the airport, the repeated strikes and explosions have taken a psychological toll on families, prompting some to consider moving to safer areas inside and outside Aden. Ahmed Awadh, a resident of Aden’s Khor Maksar district, near the airport, said the attacks have left children struggling with fear and anxiety.

“An explosion jolts the children awake in terror, leaving them unable to sleep for the rest of the night. Even the sound of an ordinary airplane now strikes fear into my family,” Awadh told Al Jazeera.

He said the attacks have disrupted schools and businesses, prompting families to rush home and some parents to keep their children away from school. Some families have sent vulnerable relatives, including children and elderly people, to neighbouring Lahj and Abyan provinces or other districts of Aden. Others have rented homes further away from the airport.

Awadh, who lives with 10 other family members, said they have taken precautions by keeping children away from windows during attacks. He and his neighbours have also created a WhatsApp group to check on one another after each explosion.

“The [Aden] airport, which serves the civilian population, as well as other civilian infrastructure and residential areas, must not be targeted,” Awadh said.

Aden, Yemen’s second-most important city after the Houthi-held capital, Sanaa, suffered extensive destruction in early 2015 during fierce fighting between the Houthis and their opponents, as well as air strikes by the Saudi-led coalition.

Even after the Houthis were driven out, the city continued to experience sporadic clashes between rival anti-Houthi factions, which sometimes turned their weapons on each other.

Adeeb al-Shatri, a professor of journalism at Aden and Hadramout universities, said the latest wave of Houthi missile attacks had compounded the suffering of a city already plagued by lawlessness and insecurity.

He questioned why Yemen’s internationally recognised government had left Aden, its temporary capital and seat of government, vulnerable to Houthi attacks without adequate air defences to intercept missiles and drones.

“Aden is currently the capital, housing both major and minor state institutions. Therefore, the legitimate government must protect it,” al-Shatri told Al Jazeera.

The Yemeni military has claimed to have air defence forces in Aden, with reports of drone interceptions before they reached civilian areas.

Yemen’s Information Minister, Moammar al-Eryani, did not respond to Al Jazeera’s request for comment on criticism that air defence systems have been inadequate in protecting Aden.

Al-Shatri argued that only a small proportion of Aden’s wealthier residents could afford to stockpile food and other essential supplies in preparation for an emergency. Most residents, he said, were already struggling to feed their families.

“In Europe and other stable Arab countries, people stockpile food during crises, but in Aden, people need three times their current salaries just to live a simple life,” he said.

Al-Shatri also challenged the notion that Houthi attacks had brought businesses and education in Aden to a complete standstill.

“People’s movement in the city returned to normal just an hour after the explosion because they have to keep moving to earn money and secure their daily bread,” he said. “If work were to stop, it would lead to a financial crisis, and they would be unable to provide food for themselves.”
news.content: همزمان با اصابت موشک‌های حوثی‌ها به عدن، ساکنان از ترس بازگشت به جنگ همه جانبه مواد غذایی ذخیره می‌کنند و نقشه‌های فرار را آماده می‌کنند. برای محمد عبدالمالک، انفجارهای قدرتمندی که طی ماه گذشته به طور مکرر به شهر عدن در جنوب یمن حمله کرده است، هشداری شوم برای روزهای تاریک‌تر در پیش است. حوثی‌های یمن مدعی حمله به چندین مکان در عدن، از جمله فرودگاه بین‌المللی، اردوگاه‌های نظامی، بندر شهر و کاخ ریاست‌جمهوری - که به عنوان پایگاهی برای دولت یمن عمل می‌کند، شده‌اند. عبدالملک از ترس اینکه شهر بار دیگر به خشونت‌های گسترده سقوط کند، اقدامات احتیاطی را انجام داده است. او غذا انباشته کرده و ماشینش را برای یک سفر طولانی در صورت نیاز به رفتن آماده کرده است. عبدالملک به الجزیره گفت: «من در مورد خودم و دوستان نزدیکم به شما خواهم گفت: ما شروع به خرید و ذخیره مواد اولیه مانند شکر و سایر مواد اولیه کرده‌ایم. اگر وضعیت امنیتی بیشتر بدتر شود و نهادهای دولتی سقوط کنند، برنامه B او این است که با خانواده‌اش از عدن فرار کند و به شبوا، به شمال شرقی، یا از مسیر سابق حضرم، پناهنده شود. شهر ماشینم را آماده کردم، آن را چک کردم و سوخت اضطراری را کنار گذاشتم. من آماده‌ام خانواده‌ام را جمع کنم و در یک لحظه بیرون بیایم.» پس از چهار سال آرامش نسبی، جنگ یمن در ماه‌های اخیر، به‌ویژه از اوایل سپتامبر، زمانی که حوثی‌ها حمله بزرگی را برای تصرف مناطق تحت کنترل دولت در غرب این کشور آغاز کردند، دوباره شعله‌ور شده است.

روزنامه «نوایا گازتا» یکی از برجسته‌ترین رسانه‌های خبری مستقل که همچنان در روسیه فعالیت می‌کرد، اعلام کرده است که در پی فشارهای دولت، به زودی تعطیل می‌شود.

سرگئی سوکولوف، سردبیر این روزنامه، در بیانیه‌ای که در یوتیوب منتشر شد، گفت که «نوایا گازتا دیگر وجود نخواهد داشت.»

استیون روزنبرگ، سردبیر بخش روسی بی‌بی‌سی می‌گوید نوایا گازتا، مقام‌های روسیه را به «قتل» یک روزنامه متهم کرده است.

این روزنامه حکم تخلیه دفتر خود را دریافت کرده و سامانه‌ای که به این روزنامه امکان می‌داد از کمک‌های مالی خوانندگانش برخوردار شود، از کار انداخته شده و این روزنامه دیگر هیچ راهی برای تأمین هزینه‌های انتشار خود ندارد.

این روزنامه به پوشش انتقادی درباره مسائل سیاسی و اجتماعی روسیه و گزارش‌های تحقیقی بی‌پروا درباره موضوعاتی مانند فساد، نقض حقوق بشر شناخته می‌شود. سردبیر بخش روسی بی‌بی‌سی می‌گوید که اینها موضوعاتی خطرناک در روسیه است.

دیمیتری موراتوف، سردبیر پیشین نوایا گازتا، در سال ۲۰۲۱ به‌دلیل تلاش‌هایش برای دفاع از آزادی بیان در روسیه، به‌طور مشترک برنده جایزه صلح نوبل شد.

اما این جایزه مانع از آن نشد که مقام‌های روسیه در سال ۲۰۲۳ او را در فهرست «عوامل خارجی» قرار دهند. مقام‌های روسیه اغلب از این اصطلاح برای محدود و مجازات کردن منتقدان از آن استفاده می‌کنند.

از زمان تأسیس این روزنامه در سال ۱۹۹۳، چند روزنامه‌نگاران آن پس از انتشار مطالب انتقادی درباره مقام‌های دولتی به قتل رسیده‌اند و اخیرا هم برخی از آنها در فهرست «عوامل خارجی» قرار گرفتند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

آنا پولیتکوفسکایا، از جمله این روزنامه‌نگاران بود که ۲۰ سال پیش در راه‌پله ساختمان محل سکونتش هدف گلوله قرار گرفت و کشته شد. جنگ‌های چچن از جمله موضوعاتی بود که او درباره‌اش گزارش تهیه کرده بود.

خانم پولیتکوفسکایا یکی از معدود روزنامه نگاران روسی بود که در باره نقض حقوق بشر در چچن می نوشت و بسیاری از مردم روسیه تصور میکنند قتل وی سازمان یافته بوده است.

پس از آغاز حمله گسترده روسیه به اوکراین در سال ۲۰۲۲ هم انتشار نسخه چاپی این روزنامه در روسیه متوقف شد و مقام‌ها وب‌سایت آن را مسدود کردند اما  خوانندگان  با استفاده از وی‌پی‌ان و فیلترشکن محدودیت‌های رسمی دسترسی به وب‌سایت را دور می‌زدند و مطالبش را می‌خواندند.

کمتر از یک سال پیش پلیس روسیه دفتر تحریریه روزنامه را بازرسی کرد و سپس یک روزنامه‌نگار باسابقه آن بازداشت و به «دسترسی غیرقانونی به اطلاعات رایانه‌ای» متهم شد.

در ارتباط با همین پرونده، سرگئی سوکولوف، سردبیر روزنامه، نیز اخیرا برای بازجویی به اداره پلیس احضار شد و خانه‌اش مورد بازرسی قرار گرفت.

با وجود افزایش فشارها، نوایا گازتا توانسته بود به فعالیت خود هرچند در مقیاسی محدودتر ادامه دهد.

تعطیلی این روزنامه نشانه دیگری از بسته‌تر شدن فضای سیاسی و اجتماعی روسیه و تمایل بیشتر مقام‌های این کشور به اقتدارگرایی تفسیر شده است.

news.originalContent:
Israeli forces are treating the ‘Yellow Line’, which is encroaching westward, as ‘a kill zone’, the OHCHR says.

Israeli forces in Gaza are displacing more Palestinians and their actions continue to raise concerns of ethnic cleansing, the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) has warned.

Palestinians are being repeatedly displaced by Israeli forces into a decreasing fraction of the besieged enclave, an OHCHR statement issued on Friday said.

The Israeli army is further encroaching on areas past its deployment line, also known as the “Yellow Line,” and “Israeli forces appear to treat the yellow line as a kill zone,” preventing Palestinians from returning to what is left of their homes on the other side, the UN agency said.

The OHCHR cautioned that the Israeli military is destroying remaining civilian infrastructure and attacking displacement sites, as it continues its stated aim of increasing its military deployment area to 70 percent of Gaza’s territory.

Human rights groups and aid agencies have repeatedly called on Israel to stop forcibly displacing Palestinians in Gaza and attacking shelters throughout the conflict.

The OHCHR documented the westward expansion of the Israeli military over the past two weeks, triggering new displacement of Palestinians in Shujayea, Gaza City, and in eastern Bureij, eastern Deir el-Balah and eastern al-Maghazi in Central Gaza.

The UN agency noted that in Shujayea, at least two Israeli attacks were reported on displacement camps, with explosive robots detonating the few buildings left standing in the area.

The OHCHR also said that it received reports that an Israeli drone dropped munitions on a tent housing displaced Palestinians at the Shujayea junction on Sunday. The Palestinian Ministry of Public Works and Housing in Gaza said the resulting fire displaced 200 families comprising 800 people.

Ajith Sunghay, head of the OHCHR in occupied Palestine, said the “nightmare of displacement” in Gaza was both “acute and chronic”.

“Those displaced before the announcement of a ceasefire have little to no prospect of return to the areas they fled, most of which are inaccessible because they fall beyond the so-called Yellow Line. And they continue to be displaced again and again.”

Despite an ongoing ceasefire, Israeli attacks on Gaza have continued, with at least 1,574 people killed and 5,687 others wounded since the agreement came into place on October 11, 2025, according to the enclave’s Ministry of Health.

Since the genocidal war began in October 2023, Israeli attacks have killed at least 74,570 people and wounded 175,808 others.
news.content: دفتر کمیساریای عالی حقوق بشر سازمان ملل (OHCHR) هشدار داده است که نیروهای اسرائیلی با "خط زرد" که به سمت غرب تجاوز می کند به عنوان "منطقه کشتار" رفتار می کنند. در بیانیه OHCHR که روز جمعه منتشر شد، آمده است که فلسطینیان به طور مکرر توسط نیروهای اسرائیلی به بخش رو به کاهشی از محاصره تحت محاصره آواره می شوند. ارتش اسرائیل در حال تجاوز بیشتر به مناطق گذشته از خط استقرار خود است که به عنوان "خط زرد" نیز شناخته می شود و "به نظر می رسد نیروهای اسرائیلی با خط زرد بازگشت به خانه های خود به عنوان یک منطقه کشتار در خانه های خود برخورد می کنند." آژانس سازمان ملل متحد گفت. OHCHR هشدار داد که ارتش اسرائیل در حال تخریب زیرساخت های غیرنظامی باقی مانده و حمله به مکان های آوارگان است، زیرا به هدف اعلام شده خود برای افزایش منطقه استقرار نظامی خود به 70 درصد از خاک غزه ادامه می دهد. گروه های حقوق بشر و آژانس های کمک بارها از اسرائیل خواسته اند که آواره اجباری فلسطینیان در سراسر غزه و حمله به غزه را متوقف کند. OHCHR گسترش ارتش اسرائیل به سمت غرب را در دو هفته گذشته مستند کرده است که باعث آوارگی جدید فلسطینی ها در شجایه، شهر غزه، و در شرق بریج، شرق دیرالبلاح و شرق المغازی در غزه مرکزی شده است.

Welcome to State of the Day,

Nothing says independent media like a little sponsored damage control,

The Daily Wire Has Become A Crisis PR Firm For Its Sponsors

The Daily Wire has built a media empire telling its audience who’s lying, who’s corrupt, and which countries are our greatest allies. But when the people keeping the lights on find themselves in hot water, a studio, camera crew, and an hour of airtime suddenly appear to tell their side of the story.

Enter Ben Shapiro and Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour.

Utah dropped 14 criminal counts against the prediction-market company and its co-founders Wednesday, accusing them of promoting illegal online gambling. What else happened Wednesday? Shapiro released an hour-long interview with Mansour, giving the exec a platform to explain why his company is actually … a force for good?

I’ve always said the best thing we can do for young men is introduce them to crippling gambling habits. Glad Ben gets it too.

Shapiro said the interview was recorded 48 hours before Utah announced the criminal charges. But don’t be mistaken; this was no coincidence.

Utah had already announced the suit against Kalshi over its sports contracts earlier this month, so the CEO knew the site was in its crosshairs.

Releasing the interview the same day the charges dropped, the Daily Wire had a fresh, polished defense of Kalshi’s business model straight from the CEO ready to go just as the company’s legal troubles became a national headline.

Crisis PR firms everywhere — take notes.

One other little detail worth mentioning: Kalshi is a paid advertising sponsor of the Daily Wire.

Shapiro discloses that relationship … good. We’re all big fans of honesty around here.

However, the introduction quickly goes from forthright to hilarious.

Shapiro goes on to argue prediction markets are more reliable than political pundits because people who put money on the line have a financial incentive to get things right.

“Prices beat pundits,” says the pundit.

Shapiro, who’s selling you on the virtues of a glorified sportsbook that’s supposedly better than political pundits, is interviewing the CEO of a company that bankrolls his own political commentary media conglomerate.

The irony is so thick I asked myself if the interview was some elaborate form of satirical advertisement, but that’s a bit too advanced for the folks at the Wire.

To Shapiro’s credit, he does ask about the risks. He presses Mansour on young men losing money on betting platforms and asks how Kalshi plans to convince the public and regulators that its products aren’t just another way to gamble.

Mansour acknowledges the concern but insists that Kalshi operates differently from traditional sportsbooks, where the house profits from customer losses. He argues that prediction markets can be a healthier alternative.

Basically, the frat bros can lose their money as long as Kalshi isn’t the one betting against them.

Utah’s case isn’t some mysterious attack on an otherwise uncontroversial business. An undercover investigator placed 12 sports wagers on Kalshi, risking $114.87 in total. The state argues that these transactions violated its gambling laws.

Kalshi maintains that it operates under the federal Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s authority, but Utah says slapping the words “prediction market” on a sports bet doesn’t magically transform your parlay into high finance.

You know I’m no business owner, but I have to say this whole stunt is a great pitch to potential ad buyers at the Daily Wire.

Who needs an outside PR firm when you’ve already got the lights, the cameras, and a confidently incorrect host ready to espouse propaganda?

Is Fox News pivoting to its post-Trump era? The answer lies in what it is — and isn’t — showing, CNN, Brian Stelter, Andrew Kirell

Fox News is having a rough October. The network’s audience fell 27 percent compared to a year ago, with an even steeper drop among younger viewers. CNN’s Brian Stelter suggests some Trump loyalists are tuning out amid frustration over everything from the Iran war to gas prices. I guess the boomers’ favorite news channel doesn’t stand the test of broken promises.

Millions Of Residents Exposed To Toxic Metals From LA Fires, Study Shows, Daily Caller News Foundation, Libby Bandelin

As if a wildfire burning up your home wasn’t bad enough, a new study found that roughly 7 million people were exposed to lead levels more than 80 times the typical average during the height of the 2025 Los Angeles fires. Burning homes, vehicles, and everyday household items sent lead, arsenic, and other nasty substances into the air. Read more from Libby Bandelin at the Daily Caller News Foundation.

Hegseth Fires Top General For Allegedly Leaking Classified Information, Daily Caller, Rebeka Zeljko

The Daily Caller’s own Rebeka Zeljko has the scoop: Pete Hegseth has booted yet another top Pentagon official, this time an Army lieutenant general accused of leaking classified information. Brett Sylvia reportedly failed three polygraphs and is under investigation by the DOJ. The Pentagon’s leak hunt continues, though three previously fired officials were never charged. It’s getting harder to keep track of who’s being investigated, who’s been fired, and who’s actually been caught doing anything.

Nvidia Chief Seen as Target of Chinese Spy Plot, The New York Times, Jonathan Swan, Maggie Haberman, Ana Swanson, Paul Mozur, Tripp Mickle, and Julian E. Barnes

Nvidia’s Jensen Huang has become one of Trump’s most influential tech advisers, helping shape the administration’s approach to AI and chip exports. So naturally, a suspected Chinese intelligence asset with close ties to the CEO set off alarms among U.S. officials. The worst part? Trump reportedly knew about the intelligence findings for nearly a year.

news.originalContent:
The Department of Justice (DOJ) issued at least three dozen subpoenas Thursday as part of its investigation into the Alaska Senate race, a source familiar confirmed to the Daily Caller News Foundation.

The subpoenas were sent to the campaign offices of former Democratic Alaska Rep. Mary Peltola and former schoolteacher Dan J. Sullivan as part of a probe into the Democrats’ alleged ballot scheme. Peltola’s campaign aides and members of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC) reportedly coordinated to recruit other Republican candidates to boost Peltola’s chances of beating Republican Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan, according to a New York Times review.

The DOJ amended its lawsuit seeking to block the certifications of the results if Sullivan loses to include details from the Times report. The new filing calls the situation a “conspiracy to undermine the integrity of the electoral process.”

Republican Alaska Gov. Mike Dunleavy directed the Department of Public Safety to investigate whether any crime took place. Alaska’s Department of Public Safety Deputy Commissioner Austin McDaniel said Thursday that the Alaska Bureau of Investigation had begun looking into the matter. (RELATED: Other Dan Sullivan Advances To General Election Against Incumbent Dan Sullivan)

Today’s New York Times reporting reveals disturbing new evidence of an organized effort to manipulate Alaska’s elections by recruiting candidates—including one with the same name as an incumbent U.S. Senator—to deliberately confuse voters and misdirect their votes. The Alaska Division of Elections investigated these very concerns in June of this year. The new reporting substantially supports the Division’s findings. I am therefore directing the Department of Public Safety to investigate whether this scheme violated Alaska’s laws and whether criminal charges or civil action are warranted. The evidence will determine what happens next. Alaskans have a fundamental right to vote for the candidate they actually intend to support. Deliberately tricking voters into casting their ballots for someone else strikes at the integrity of our elections. Anyone or any organization found to have broken the law must be held accountable.

Multiple grand jury subpoenas will be issued in the coming days and preservation orders regarding text messages and emails are being prepared for cell phone companies to help build the case, sources told Fox News Wednesday.

Aides from the DSCC reportedly introduced Democratic operative Jerid Kurtz to former Peltola campaign manager Elisa Rios and former chief of staff Anton McParland. Kurtz reportedly traveled to Alaskan communities to recruit residents to run as Republicans. The other Sullivan, who supported Peltola’s candidacy, agreed to run.

Alaska’s open voting system made this scheme possible, given that candidates can claim any party affiliation on the ballot without being vetted by parties themselves. Republicans backed an effort to help a candite serving time in a New York prison stay on the ballot when Peltola ran for reelection to the House in 2024.

Text messages showed that members of the DSCC and Peltola’s campaign considered creating a MAGA Party, although the plans never came to fruition, according to the Times.

Peltola’s campaign denied any involvement with either Sullivan’s campaigns. She is the only Democrat who will appear on the ballot.

The other Sullivan changed his party affiliation from Republican to unaffiliated Monday, eight days before the general election, according to the Alaska Beacon, a local outlet.

Democratic strategist Amber Lee authored a press release announcing the other Sullivan’s candidacy, metadata reviewed by the DCNF showed. Lee told The Hill in January that she believed there was a good chance Peltola could defeat Sullivan and previously hoped Peltola would run for governor.

Division of Elections Director Carol Beecher informed Sullivan in an Aug. 26 letter that his declaration of candidacy “was not filed in order to declare an actual good-faith candidacy,” but rather to confuse voters into voting for the wrong Sullivan. After Sullivan appealed the ruling, Superior Court Judge Thomas Matthews ruled he could remain on the ballot for the state’s primary.

The Alaska Supreme Court overturned that ruling in a June 30 decision and allowed the other Sullivan to be on the ballot. The DSCC and Peltola’s campaign celebrated the high court’s decision, according to the Times.
news.content:
وزارت دادگستری (DOJ) روز پنجشنبه حداقل سه دوجین احضاریه را به عنوان بخشی از تحقیقات خود در مورد رقابت در سنای آلاسکا صادر کرد، یک منبع آشنا به بنیاد Daily Caller News تایید کرد. این احضاریه ها به دفاتر مبارزات انتخاباتی مری پلتولا، نماینده سابق دموکرات آلاسکا و معلم سابق مدرسه، دان جی. سالیوان، به عنوان بخشی از یک طرح کاوشگر در انتخابات دموکراتیک ارسال شد. بر اساس بررسی نیویورک تایمز، دستیاران مبارزات انتخاباتی پلتولا و اعضای کمیته مبارزات انتخاباتی سناتورهای دموکرات (DSCC) برای جذب سایر نامزدهای جمهوری خواه برای افزایش شانس پلتولا برای غلبه بر سناتور جمهوری خواه آلاسکا، دان سالیوان، هماهنگی کردند. وزارت دادگستری شکایت خود را اصلاح کرد که به دنبال آن بود تا در صورت از دست دادن جزئیات گزارش های Sullivan تایم، از دست دادن گواهینامه های نتایج تایمز جلوگیری کند. پرونده جدید این وضعیت را "توطئه ای برای تضعیف یکپارچگی روند انتخابات" می خواند.
مایک دانلیوی، فرماندار جمهوری خواه آلاسکا، به وزارت امنیت عمومی دستور داد تا در مورد اینکه آیا جرمی رخ داده است یا خیر. آستین مک دانیل، معاون کمیسر اداره امنیت عمومی آلاسکا، پنجشنبه گفت که اداره تحقیقات آلاسکا بررسی این موضوع را آغاز کرده است. (مرتبط: دیگر دن سالیوان به انتخابات عمومی در برابر دن سالیوان پیشروی می کند)
گزارش امروز نیویورک تایمز شواهد نگران‌کننده جدیدی از تلاش سازمان‌یافته برای دستکاری در انتخابات آلاسکا با به‌کارگیری نامزدها - از جمله نامزدی همنام با سناتور کنونی ایالات‌متحده - نشان می‌دهد.
