روزنامه «نوایا گازتا» یکی از برجسته‌ترین رسانه‌های خبری مستقل که همچنان
در روسیه فعالیت می‌کند، اعلام کرده است که در پی فشارهای دولت، ماه آینده تعطیل خواهد
شد.

سرگئی سوکولوف، سردبیر این روزنامه، در بیانیه‌ای که در یوتیوب منتشر شد،
گفت:
: «نوایا گازتا دیگر وجود نخواهد داشت.»

این روزنامه می‌گوید مقام‌ها آن را مجبور به تخلیه دفترش در مسکو کرده‌اند،
تمام منابع مالی آن قطع شده و خبرنگارانش نیز با فشارها و پیگردهای قضایی روبه‌رو هستند.

این روزنامه به دلیل پوشش انتقادی و گزارش‌های تحقیقی درباره مسائل سیاسی
و اجتماعی روسیه شناخته می‌شود.

دیمیتری موراتوف، سردبیر پیشین نوایا گازتا، در سال ۲۰۲۱ به‌دلیل تلاش‌هایش
برای دفاع از آزادی بیان در روسیه، به‌طور مشترک برنده جایزه صلح نوبل شد.

از زمان تأسیس این روزنامه در سال ۱۹۹۳، چندین نفر از روزنامه‌نگاران آن پس
از انتشار گزارش‌های انتقادی درباره مقام‌های دولتی به قتل رسیده‌اند.

پس از آغاز حمله گسترده روسیه به اوکراین در سال ۲۰۲۲ نیز انتشار
نسخه چاپی این روزنامه در روسیه متوقف شد و مقام‌ها وب‌سایت آن را مسدود کردند.

افزایش قیمت نفت پس از انتشار گزارش‌هایی درباره برخورد چند نفتکش با مین‌های دریایی در تنگه هرمز، به روند صعودی خود در روز جمعه ادامه داد.

این حوادث بار دیگر خطر اختلال در عرضه و انتقال نفت را برجسته کرده است.

قیمت نفت خام برنت برای تحویل در ماه دسامبر با یک دلار و ۲۰ سنت افزایش به ۱۱۶ دلار و ۸ سنت در هر بشکه رسید.

بهای نفت خام وست تگزاس اینترمدیت آمریکا هم  با یک دلار و ۳۷ سنت افزایش، به ۱۰۳ دلار و ۳۷ سنت در هر بشکه رسید.

قیمت نفت برنت از ابتدای ماه تاکنون نزدیک به ۱۱ درصد و قیمت نفت خام آمریکا حدود ۱۴ درصد افزایش یافته است.

قرار است امروز نشست وزرای امور خارجه گروه ۲۰ در آتلانتا ایالت جورجیا برگزار شود.

این نشست تنها چند روز پیش از انتخابات سرنوشت‌ساز میان‌دوره‌ای آمریکا برگزار می‌شود و مارکو روبیو، وزیر خارجه آمریکا، میزبان همتایان خود در گروه ۲۰ از جمله سرگئی لاوروف، وزیر خارجه روسیه، خواهد بود.

این نشست در شرایطی برگزار می‌شود که انتظار می‌رود مذاکرات با اختلاف‌نظرهای جدی همراه باشد. جنگ‌های اوکراین و ایران و افزایش شدید قیمت انرژی، تنش‌ها میان کشورها را تشدید کرده است.

انتظار نمی‌رود نشست گروه ۲۰ که متشکل از اقتصادهای بزرگی همچون چین، هند، روسیه، ژاپن، آلمان و فرانسه، دستاوردهای چشمگیری داشته باشد؛ چرا که اختلافات بر سر جنگ روسیه علیه اوکراین و پیامدهای درگیری با ایران همچنان پابرجاست.

دولت ترامپ که قرار است ریاست دوره‌ای گروه ۲۰ را به بریتانیا واگذار کند، معتقد است این نهاد از مأموریت اصلی خود فاصله گرفته است.

واشنگتن وعده داده است که گروه ۲۰ را به هدف اصلی خود، یعنی تقویت رشد اقتصادی بازگرداند و استدلال می‌کند که امنیت و رفاه اقتصادی به‌طور جدایی‌ناپذیری به یکدیگر وابسته‌اند.

ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان سعودی روز جمعه اعلام کرد که یک پهپاد حوثی‌های یمن را در منطقه مکه رهگیری و منهدم کرده است؛ با این حال، حوثی‌ها
ساعاتی بعد هرگونه تلاش برای هدف قرار دادن این شهر را تکذیب کردند.

ترکی مالکی، سخنگوی ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان، در پیامی در شبکه اجتماعی
ایکس نوشت:
«یک پهپاد که از طرف شبه‌نظامیان تروریست حوثی به پرواز درآمده بود،
در منطقه مکه رهگیری و منهدم شد.»

منبع تصویر، AFP via Getty Images

نتایج نهایی انتخابات پارلمانی اسرائیل تأیید می‌کند که ائتلاف بنیامین
نتانیاهو با ۵۳ کرسی بیشترین کرسی‌ها را به دست آورده است، اما نتوانسته اکثریت لازم را کسب کند.

ائتلاف مخالفان دولت به رهبری گادی آیزنکوت، ۴۸ کرسی دارد ، در حالی که احزاب عرب موفق به کسب ۱۹ کرسی شده‌اند.

بنیامین نتانیاهو و گادی آیزنکوت هر دو اعلام کردند که قصد دارند دولت
آینده را تشکیل دهند.

مذاکرات برای تشکیل دولت ممکن است چند هفته طول بکشد و در صورت بی‌نتیجه
ماندن، احتمال برگزاری انتخابات مجدد وجود دارد.

آقای آیزنکوت، بنیامین نتانیاهو را متهم کرده است که با طرح ادعای دخالت
خارجی به نفع احزاب عرب، تلاش می‌کند نتیجه انتخابات را بی‌اعتبار جلوه دهد.

‌قطر و ترکیه گزارش‌های مربوط به دخالت‌شان در این انتخابات را رد کرده‌اند.

اسکات بسنت، وزیر دارایی آمریکا، می‌گوید فشارهای اقتصادی واشنگتن علیه جمهوری اسلامی به‌شدت افزایش یافته و حکومت ایران در تامین منابع مالی مورد نیاز خود، از جمله پرداخت حقوق نیروهای نظامی و حمایت از گروه‌های متحدش در منطقه، با مشکلات جدی روبه‌رو شده است.

آقای بسنت در گفت‌وگو با شبکه سی‌ان‌بی‌سی گفت عملیات موسوم به «طرد اقتصادی» راه‌های دسترسی جمهوری اسلامی به منابع مالی را محدود کرده و سپاه پاسداران حتی در پرداخت حقوق نیروهای خود با مشکل مواجه شده است. او همچنین گفت که مقام‌های سپاه در محافل عمومی و خصوصی درباره احتمال فروپاشی اقتصادی ابراز نگرانی می‌کنند.

وزیر دارایی آمریکا افزود که محدودیت دسترسی جمهوری اسلامی به دلار و منابع ارزی، توانایی تهران برای تامین مالی گروه‌های متحدش، از جمله حوثی‌های یمن، حماس و حزب‌الله لبنان را کاهش داده است. او تاکید کرد که واشنگتن اجازه نخواهد داد جمهوری اسلامی به تامین مالی فعالیت‌هایی که آمریکا آنها را تروریستی می‌داند، ادامه دهد.

آقای بسنت همچنین گفت برآوردهای داخلی دولت آمریکا نشان می‌دهد اقتصاد ایران ممکن است در فاصله مارس ۲۰۲۶ تا مارس ۲۰۲۷ تا ۲۵ درصد کوچک شود. او عملیات «طرد اقتصادی» را شدیدترین اقدام برای منزوی کردن اقتصاد یک کشور در تاریخ توصیف کرد.

دولت دونالد ترامپ عملیات «طرد اقتصادی» را در ۲۴ اوت آغاز کرد. هدف اعلام‌شده این عملیات، قطع مسیرهای انتقال پول، جلوگیری از دور زدن تحریم‌ها و محدود کردن درآمدهای نفتی جمهوری اسلامی است

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has revealed a new lineup of noncitizens accused of voter fraud.

Documents obtained by the Daily Caller detail 17 people connected to ICE investigations and arrests involving election-related offenses, including noncitizens who allegedly admitted to unlawfully registering to vote or casting ballots.

The documents identify individuals accused of illegally voting in federal, state, and local elections, including illegal immigrants with criminal records and lawful permanent residents. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: ICE Drops New Batch Of Illegal Immigrants Accused Of Voter Fraud Ahead Of Midterms)

The criminal-history details and allegations are based on documents the Caller obtained, which do not establish that every individual named has been convicted of an election-related offense.

🚨 EXCLUSIVE: ICE arrested 13 noncitizens accused of voter fraud ahead of the 2026 midterms, per @DailyCaller. Names & alleged illegal voting: • Juan Carlos Matute-Hernandez — 2026 • Aden Hassan Aden — 2020 • Arturo Salazar Garcia — 2024 • Jaimie Sosa-Sardina — 2024 • Marva Marie Cook — 2022 • Braulio Osiel Zapata Perez — 2024 • Mai Tran — 2024 • Jose Luis Matute Chaviel — 2024 • Phath Vorn — 1992 • Axel Bemjarmin Alarcon Duarte — federal election • Darwin Yoel Zelaya-Orellana — 2026 • Servando Alejandro-Torres — 2024 • Jairo Ivan Vazquez Montano — 2022 The cases include allegations of illegal voting across multiple election cycles. Read more👇

Among them was Anthony Tyrone Higgs, a lawful permanent resident from the Bahamas who allegedly voted illegally in a 2020 election. Higgs has a criminal record that includes convictions for armed robbery with a deadly weapon, grand larceny, domestic violence, simple assault, and resisting arrest, according to the documents.

Carlos Javier Alamo-Sorino, a Cuban national in ICE custody, allegedly admitted to illegally voting. Paroled into the U.S. under the Obama administration, Sorino has convictions for sexual assault, another sexual offense, robbery, larceny, and harassing communications, according to ICE.

The agency also identified several individuals with final orders of removal. Jose Zapete-Quinonez, a Guatemalan national, allegedly voted illegally in 2021, while Julio De La Rosa, a Mexican national, allegedly voted in 2020 and has convictions for strangulation, assault, violating a court order, and violating probation.

Cliff Medgy Sanon, a Haitian national with a final order of removal, allegedly voted illegally in 2022 and was convicted of receiving stolen property, according to the documents.

We cannot and will not allow the votes of American citizens to be cancelled out by non-citizens illegally voting in our elections. @HSI_HQ will continue to find and arrest non-citizen voters to restore security and confidence to our elections.

In response to the ongoing investigations, ICE Public Affairs Assistant Director Micah Bock told the Caller, “Secure elections protect our nation’s sovereignty and Americans’ sacred right to vote.”

Bock further noted the Trump administration is committed to addressing what it views as failures in the Biden administration’s immigration policies, arguing that illegal voting undermines the votes of American citizens. (RELATED: ROOKE: The Left Doesn’t Want You Asking Why One Small Texas Town Was Able To Make Huge Dent In Illegal Immigration)

“Each vote by a criminal illegal alien cancels out a vote of an American citizen. This nationwide crackdown shows that President Trump, Secretary Mullin and acting ICE Director David J. Venturella are committed to fixing the failed immigration policies of the Biden administration that enabled this mess,” Bock wrote.

The ICE documents also identified several other individuals accused of illegally voting despite having no legal basis to remain in the United States.

Omar Ponce-Juarez, a Mexican national, allegedly voted illegally in a 2022 election, while Ramiro Daniel Cuarezma Aleman, a Nicaraguan national currently in ICE custody, allegedly cast a ballot in the 2024 election.

Karl Stephen Branzon Pau, a Philippine national, was also listed in the documents, accused of illegally voting in 2024. Pau had overstayed his authorized period of admission in the U.S. by 22 years, according to ICE.

The ICE documents also identified four lawful permanent residents accused of illegally registering to vote or casting ballots in American elections.

Puja Bagga, an Indian national, allegedly registered unlawfully and voted three times: in a 2015 local election and state elections in 2022 and 2024.

The patriots of @ICEgov are hard at work every single day across America, including in South Carolina to undo the damage from four long years of Biden’s open borders. Arresting and deporting killers, violent assailants, burglars, and drug traffickers like these is how we protect our communities, save lives, and make America safe again. 🧵

Vladislav Vaska, a Russian national, was arrested for allegedly voting illegally in 2024, while Joshua Edzie, a Ghanaian national, allegedly voted in November 2024 and August 2025.

Mariana Alexandra Dewey, a Peruvian national, also allegedly voted in 2024 and was convicted of disorderly election conduct, according to the documents. (RELATED: ’60 Minutes’ Under Fire After Full DHS Interview Reveals What Was Left On Cutting Room Floor)

The list obtained by the Caller also included Christian Lawrence, a Liberian national who allegedly voted in 2012 and 2016. Lawrence was convicted in 2013 of failing to register as a sex offender and was charged with failure to appear in court.

Lawrence Cole, a Jamaican national convicted of felony drug sales during the Clinton administration, allegedly voted in the 2004 and 2008 general elections and the 2008 presidential primary, according to the agency.

Lise Johnson, a Canadian national, was arrested on felony voter fraud charges after allegedly voting in 2022, according to the documents.

Gabriel Mendoza Vicente, a Guatemalan national convicted of a licensing violation and reckless driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, allegedly voted in 2024, while Gerardo Nieves-Borja, a Mexican national accused of illegally voting that year, has also been charged with driving under the influence, according to ICE.

news.originalContent:
Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty Images

As homes ignited and burned down during the 2025 Los Angeles fires, millions of California residents were exposed to a high concentration of airborne toxic metals, a new study discovered.

Almost two years ago, wildfires spread through southern California killing at least 31 people and destroying 16,000 structures — but the extent of the blaze’s far-reaching effects remained unclear. Researchers measured the chemical signatures emitted between urban fires and wildfire smoke to find that approximately 7 million Californians inhaled deadly heavy lead poisoning in the air during the first 24 hours of the devastating fires, a study published Wednesday in Science Advances found.

While some allege that climate change caused these rapid spreading blazes, the Democratic-run state and city governments appeared to not properly prepare for the wildfires and botched their responses to them. For example, Los Angeles government officials caught heat for letting scores of the city’s fire hydrants run dry and for cutting $17.6 million from the Los Angeles Fire Department’s budget, a move approved by Democratic Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass.

For the study, researchers measured particles present in the smoke every hour during the fires’ blaze and recorded the data in the Atmospheric Science and Chemistry mEasurement NeTwork (ASCENT), according to the study. ASCENT is the U.S.’ first measurement network able to measure the chemical composition of airborne particles in real time, a researcher told the Associated Press. (RELATED: EPA And Private Business Helps LA Wildfire Survivors Where City Won’t)

The researchers compared the chemical makeup of the smoke from the LA fires with smoke from a 2024 wildfire in Riverside County which mostly burnt vegetation, the study reported. By contrasting the measurements in these two smoke plumes, scientists found the LA fire contained 50 times more lead, three times more arsenic and seven times more halogens. At the peak of the burning, about 7 million people were exposed for a full day to lead levels more than 80 times the typical average, the study found.

“One of the real advantages of this study is that it had the opportunity to make measurements sort of hour-by-hour across the sampling network,” Ed Avol a professor at University of Southern California, who was not involved in the study, told the AP. “And typically we make measurements of airborne particulates and so forth a couple of times a week, at best.”

Thousands of homes burned during the LA fires and toxins from incinerated cars, paint, furniture and chemicals under sinks entered the air the study found. In the aftermath of the fires, researchers also linked this smoke inhalation to tens of thousands of deaths across the United States in a previous study, the AP reported in February.

“We saw this coming, and we have said, ‘I told you so’ every time there’s been a super fire. This time, the super fire happens to be even more catastrophic, because it’s happening in one of the most densely-populated areas in the United States,” Edward Ring, director of water and energy policy for the California Policy Center, told the Daily Caller News Foundation on Jan. 11, 2025 — days after the wildfire spread through the City of Angels.

“It’s the same message, which is that we have neglected our water infrastructure. We have mismanaged our forests and chaparral in the name of environmentalism, and we’re paying the price,” Ring added.

Editor’s note: This story has been updated to include additional reporting.
news.content:
عکس از جاستین سالیوان/گتی ایماژ
طبق یک مطالعه جدید، با شعله‌ور شدن و سوختن خانه‌ها در جریان آتش‌سوزی‌های 2025 لس‌آنجلس، میلیون‌ها نفر از ساکنان کالیفرنیا در معرض غلظت بالایی از فلزات سمی معلق در هوا قرار گرفتند. تقریباً دو سال پیش، آتش‌سوزی‌های جنگلی در جنوب کالیفرنیا گسترش یافت و حداقل 31 نفر را کشت و 16000 ساختمان را ویران کرد - اما تأثیرات وحشیانه این آتش‌سوزی همچنان بسیار زیاد است. مطالعه‌ای که روز چهارشنبه در Science Advances منتشر شد، نشان داد که محققان علائم شیمیایی منتشر شده بین آتش‌سوزی‌های شهری و دود آتش‌سوزی‌های جنگلی را اندازه‌گیری کردند و دریافتند که تقریباً 7 میلیون کالیفرنیایی در طول 24 ساعت اول آتش‌سوزی‌های ویرانگر، مسمومیت شدید سرب را در هوا استنشاق کردند. در حالی که برخی ادعا می کنند که تغییرات آب و هوایی باعث گسترش سریع این آتش سوزی ها شده است، به نظر می رسد که دولت های ایالتی و شهری که توسط دموکرات ها اداره می شود به درستی برای آتش سوزی های جنگلی آماده نشده اند و واکنش خود را به آنها ناکام گذاشته اند. به عنوان مثال، مقامات دولتی لس آنجلس به دلیل خشک شدن تعداد زیادی از شیرهای آتش نشانی شهر و کاهش 17 دلار داغ داغ شدند. 6 میلیون از بودجه سازمان آتش نشانی لس آنجلس، اقدامی که توسط شهردار دموکرات لس آنجلس، کارن باس تایید شده است. طبق این مطالعه، محققان برای این مطالعه، ذرات موجود در دود را هر ساعت در طول آتش سوزی اندازه گیری کردند و داده ها را در شبکه اندازه گیری علوم و شیمی جوی (ASCENT) ثبت کردند. ASCENT اولین شبکه اندازه گیری ایالات متحده است که می تواند ترکیب شیمیایی هوابرد را اندازه گیری کند

(Photo by Anna Rose Layden/Getty Images)

Corruption has become a top issue alongside affordability for many voters ahead of Tuesday’s midterm elections.

Polls show that corruption has joined affordability as the issues voters are most concerned with in the 2026 midterm election cycle as the latter issue is often linked to President Donald Trump’s war against Iran in voters’ minds. Trump, his family and administration officials have been accused of several corrupt actions, including accepting a plane from Qatar and pardoning a cryptocurrency exchange CEO tied to Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump’s business ventures.

Sarah Chamberlain, the president of the Republican Main Street Partnership, told the Daily Caller News Foundation that corruption became the “number one issue” because of current economic conditions.

“Usually, the polling is much better for the Republican than it has been,” Chamberlain told the DCNF. “I think it’s just across the board, people are tired of the corruption … If the economy were healthier, no one would pay attention to the corruption. But because they’re struggling, corruption is a bigger deal on their minds.”

A Fox News poll found government corruption to be the top issue, with 60% of registered voters being “extremely concerned,” while 58% expressed the same level of concern about inflation. Seventy-two percent of Democrats said they were “extremely concerned” about corruption and 47% of Republicans said the same. (RELATED: Top Trump Dinner Bidders Stash Cash On Exchanges That Shut Out Americans)

Thirty-six percent of voters said government corruption was their top concern in a CNBC poll from Friday, while 34% said grocery costs were their biggest concern. Nineteen percent of registered voters said corruption was their top issue in a CNN poll from Wednesday.

A Financial Times survey found that 91% of Democratic voters and 72% of independent voters were “concerned about corruption, self-dealing or conflicts of interests” in the Trump administration. Another survey by Navigator Research, a Democratic-aligned polling organization, found that 81% of voters believe corruption in government is contributing to rising costs.

Former U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned on Oct. 13 after the administration asked her to step down. Guilfoyle allegedly asked Trump donor Eric Deters to wire $100,000 to her American Express account in exchange for getting access to Trump. The wire transfer never occurred.

The State Department’s Office of Inspector General is investigating Guilfoyle after her alleged solicitation.

Democrats vowed to investigate Trump and administration officials for corruption if they take back Congress in January, including Trump’s family and their finances. Trump made more than $1 billion off of cryptocurrency and promoted companies after buying their stock, according to a CNN investigation. He accepted a jet as a gift from Qatar to use as Air Force One, which is supposed to be transferred to his presidential library. The White House repeatedly denied any allegations of wrongdoing.

Trump pardoned Changpeng Zhao, the former CEO of cryptocurrency exchange Binance, in October 2025. Zhao and Binance had established business ties with World Liberty Financial, a crypto venture that Trump launched with his sons, Don Jr. and Eric. Trump planned to host a dinner on Nov. 22 for the top 185 holders of $TRUMP meme coin after hosting a similar event at his Washington, D.C., area golf club in 2025.

Melissa Toufanian, Navigator’s managing director, said people would not be “so worried about all this corruption if I were doing better,” according to The Financial Times.

“It’s when people are not doing so well financially and they see others benefiting to an obscene degree that the frustration begins to build,” Toufanian said.

Voters remained dissatisfied with the economy throughout the election cycle, which commonly is a top issue for voters in elections. The issue prompted Democratic strategist James Carville to coin the famous phrase, “It’s the economy, stupid,” while advising former President Bill Clinton during the 1992 presidential election.

Gas prices increased over $4 per gallon on average, while Diesel prices exceeded $6 per gallon since the Iran war began. The price of food also increased since the start of the war.

Republican Utah Sen. John Curtis urged the Senate Judiciary Committee to subpoena Donald Trump Jr. and Hunter Biden as part of an investigation into the use of presidential family relationships for private financial benefit in a letter from Sept. 22. The committee has not appeared to address the letter or began any investigations.

“[Corruption] is the number one issue right now, and it’s across the board. It’s not just Republicans,” Chamberlain said. “[Voters] are struggling to pay their bills, and they’re seeing the fraud that [Democratic Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz] was involved in. They’re seeing different types of fraud and they don’t like that because they don’t have the money to go out to dinner. So usually, fraud is not a big issue, but when you have an economy that is stretched, fraud is a big issue.”

Chamberlain said the fraud in Minnesota and a Russian oligarch paying for Donald Trump Jr.’s wedding caused corruption to become a top issue. She stated that fraud could have a major impact in the Senate races, particularly Texas and Minnesota.

Republican Minnesota Senate nominee Michele Tafoya trailed Democratic Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan by an average of five points in a state where former Vice President Kamala Harris won by a 51.1% to 46.9% margin, according to RealClearPolling. Tafoya centered her campaign around the fraud that took place statewide throughout Walz’s administration, in which Flanagan was apart of.

“I think you could really see a surprise there in which [Tafoya] wins because of the corruption out there,” Chamberlain said.

Fraudsters, most of whom were of Somali descent, allegedly stole hundreds of millions of Minnesotans’ taxpayer dollars from state programs since 2018, such as Feeding Our Future, which provided meals for low-income children during the COVID-19 pandemic. The Department of Justice (DOJ) charged 80 suspects with stealing around $250 million from Feeding Our Future.

Somali fraudsters allegedly stole over $90 million from Medicaid and child care programs throughout the state, including $46.6 million in autism fraud (EIDBI), $22 million in individualized home supports and $15.7 million in housing stabilization services, according to the DOJ.

“Billions were stolen under Peggy’s watch while she became a millionaire in public office,” Tafoya told the DCNF. “Minnesotans are tired of career politicians who let corruption run rampant while taxpayers are left holding the bill. I will be an equal opportunity pain in the ass for any corrupt politician.”

Flanagan’s campaign did not respond to the DCNF’s request for comment.

Corruption became a front-and-center issue in the Texas Senate race, where Republican Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton and Democratic Texas Senate nominee James Talarico face a competitive matchup. The Republican-controlled Texas state Legislature impeached Paxton in 2023 on bribery and abuse of power charges, although the state Senate acquitted him.

Paxton was accused of misusing the office of the attorney general to protect and assist Austin real estate developer and political donor Nate Paul, who faced federal investigations. He allegedly intervened in lawsuits, issued favorable legal opinions to protect Paul’s properties from foreclosure and hired a special prosecutor to investigate claims helpful to Paul.

Paul allegedly paid for expensive renovations to Paxton’s home and employed a woman with whom Paxton had an extramarital affair. Paxton denied all wrongdoing.

During the Republican primary, Republican Texas Sen. John Cornyn and his allies referred to Paxton as “Crooked Ken” and called him “corrupt to the core” in one ad. Talarico and his allies released attack ads calling out Paxton’s alleged corruption.

“Ken Paxton was impeached by his own party for taking bribes from wealthy donors while blocking overtime pay for Texas workers and gutting our health care,” one of Talarico’s ads said. “We cannot afford Ken Paxton’s corruption.”

An October University of Texas/Texas Politics Project poll found voters trusted Talarico more on handling corruption than Paxton by ten percentage points.

“Ken Paxton has taken on the federal bureaucrats and the corporations ripping off Texans, and he has beaten them,” Paxton spokeswoman Madison Cercy told the Post. “Democrats have spent years trying to destroy him, just like they tried with President Trump, and every attack has come up empty.”

One Republican said he was voting for Talarico over Paxton because of corruption.

“It’s just confusing to me that people are willing to throw away their morals or what they would call their Republican morals, in order purely to support keeping a Republican majority in the Senate,” Sam Clark, a Dallas Republican, told The Washington Post.

Paxton and Talarico’s campaign did not respond to the DCNF’s request for comment.

Talarico said during a Fort Worth town hall that Paxton’s net worth shot up while he was in office and argued his legal entanglements should disqualify him from being senator. Paxton’s net worth rose from $174,000 when he first entered the state Legislature in 2003 to an estimated $13 million currently, according to Forbes.

Corruption advertisements were the second most common topic for Democrats after the economy, according to a Washington Post review of more than 8,000 ads. Democrats spent about $306 million on ethics-focused ads in early October, while Republicans spent $187 million.

Former Democratic Alaska Rep. Mary Peltola’s campaign reportedly plotted to sabotage Republican Alaska Sen. Dan S. Sullivan’s reelection bid by recruiting a candidate with the same name, The New York Times reported Wednesday.

Peltola’s team actively searched for other Dan Sullivans to be on the ballot in November to boost the Democrat’s chances of winning, a review by the Times found. An operative introduced by aides from the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC) made secret trips to Alaskan communities while using a fake name and pitched his idea to would-be candidates over beers at brew pubs.

Peltola’s campaign lawyers and senior aides at the DSCC participated in regular conversations about the effort and considered forming a new political party to draw conservatives to the ballot, according to the Times.

در آستانه انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای روز سه‌شنبه، فساد در کنار استطاعت مالی برای بسیاری از رای‌دهندگان به موضوع اصلی تبدیل شده است. نظرسنجی‌ها نشان می‌دهد که فساد به استطاعت مالی ملحق شده است زیرا موضوعاتی که رای‌دهندگان در چرخه انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای 2026 بیشتر به آن توجه دارند، زیرا موضوع اخیر اغلب با جنگ رئیس‌جمهور دونالد ترامپ علیه ایران در ذهن رای‌دهندگان مرتبط است. ترامپ، خانواده و مقامات دولتی او به چندین اقدام فاسد متهم شده اند، از جمله پذیرش یک هواپیما از قطر و عفو یک مدیر عامل صرافی ارزهای دیجیتال مرتبط با سرمایه گذاری های تجاری دونالد ترامپ جونیور و اریک ترامپ. سارا چمبرلین، رئیس جمهوری خواه Main Street Partnership، به بنیاد Daily Caller News گفت که موضوع فساد فعلی تبدیل به "شرایط اقتصادی فعلی" شده است. چمبرلین به DCNF گفت: «معمولاً نظرسنجی برای جمهوری خواهان بسیار بهتر از گذشته است. "من فکر می کنم همه چیز کاملاً مشخص است، مردم از فساد خسته شده اند ... اگر اقتصاد سالم تر بود، هیچ کس به فساد توجه نمی کرد. اما از آنجایی که آنها در حال مبارزه هستند، فساد در ذهن آنها بزرگتر است." یک نظرسنجی فاکس نیوز نشان داد که فساد دولتی مهمترین موضوع است، به طوری که 60٪ از رای دهندگان ثبت نام شده "به شدت نگران" هستند، در حالی که 58٪ همان میزان نگرانی را در مورد تورم ابراز کردند. 72 درصد از دموکرات ها گفتند که "به شدت نگران" فساد هستند و 47٪ از جمهوری خواهان نیز همین را گفتند. news.originalContent: The IDF addressed the strikes carried out overnight in southern Lebanon, including in the village of Kfar Reman, saying on Monday afternoon that they began after Hezbollah terrorists launched two explosive drones at Israeli forces on the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon. No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility.   No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility. A vehicle in which two people were killed. The Associated Press reported that the vehicle belonged to the Lebanese Scout and Rescue Association, Al-Risala, and that one of those killed was a paramedic with the organization. Two other people were wounded. At the same time, Lebanese reports said a building in Kfar Reman where a large number of people were staying was also struck, killing nine people, including women and children, and wounding 11 others.   Prior to the strikes, steps were taken to mitigate harm to uninvolved individuals, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance," the IDF said in response. "The claim that several uninvolved individuals were harmed as a result of the strikes is being reviewed.” The IDF said that, in addition, following the launch of the explosive drones Sunday, “the IDF struck in the Nabatieh area and eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists. "The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians or IDF soldiers and will continue to operate to remove threats while remaining committed to the ceasefire agreement." “We lived under constant intimidation because of the bombardments on the outskirts of the village,” Fouad Chakroun, a resident of Kfar Reman told AP as he stood in front of the destroyed building. “Now they have struck the heart of the village.” Another resident, Saleh Madlij, said families and children had been staying in the building. “Are there missiles here?” he said sarcastically. “I will not leave this place.” The BBC reported that, according to Lebanese media, seven additional people were killed in strikes Sunday, while Lebanese President Joseph Aoun warned that the attacks represented a “dangerous escalation” that threatened the ceasefire.

news.originalContent: Senior government officials admit that Israel's public opinion in the international community "has never been worse." According to them, the situation only worsens, and the support the world has shown Israel following Hamas’s attack on October 7 has already been forgotten.  Follow Ynetnews on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | TikTok >> More stories: IDF releases name of fallen soldier in West Bank terror attack UN chief in Rafah crossing says world 'seen enough' of Gaza war Two Air Force pilots reminisce about their murdered brothers: 'There's no room for pain in the air' The officials added that the intensity of accusations made against Israel only increases, and attempts to equate Hamas's actions in Israel are being made, with allegations accusing IDF soldiers of sexually harassing Palestinian prisoners. Ministers in the government blame Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the complete neglect of Israel’s public relations: "There’s no leader present it’s been abandoned. A pandemic of sanctions against Israel may break out, and if we don't wake up, it will be too late. Something big needed to be done in terms of public relations, we need to rally the Jewish people and launch an international campaign. There’s no leader to head this. We’re losing. Our friends tell us: we support you, but you’re losing in the court of public opinion." A senior figure in Israel's advocacy efforts added, "They neutralized the Foreign Ministry and took away all its budget. The Foreign Ministry has no funding. To this day, no money was delivered. We’re working with a budget of 2 million shekels allocated for the war since the beginning of the year.  “Each U.S. consulate receives $5,000 a year for public relations efforts, including Independence Day events. For example, the consulate in Boston, which is also responsible for MIT, has to struggle to have such an amount. It’s ridiculous. When you already have a talented spokesman like Eylon Levy, they unjustly suspend him. He was one of the few people who did his mission in the most talented, beautiful, and correct way, and they sent him home,” the source said.   Internal reports from Israeli missions in the United States describe a very harsh picture of Israeli coverage in the American media. One report described, "The media awaited a sign from the government for a policy change, and when it arrived - it unleashed a rampage and published constant harsh criticism against Israel that had always existed. The harsh reports from Gaza, alongside internal tensions in the U.S., threaten to push moderate writers from the mainstream to adopt critical positions toward Israel and demand an immediate and permanent cease-fire.” 'the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy' “Pressure on the Biden administration to harden its stance toward Israel and condition military aid for an Israeli policy change constitutes a warning sign for the future,” the report added. “In terms of 'color,' we’re currently in a 'dark orange.' “There’s a change in stances even among staunch supporters of Israel – and while the conservative media fully supported Israel's actions in the past, this time voices questioning the proportionality of Israeli action have also been heard. However, no demand for a cease-fire is expected to appear in those media outlets. Without a fundamental change in the humanitarian issue in Gaza and/or signs on the diplomatic solution on the horizon, criticism of Israel in the media is expected to intensify,” the report read. It was added, "In the last month, the U.S. media’s spotlight turned to the worsening humanitarian crisis in Gaza, with special emphasis given to the suffering of Rafah residents against the backdrop of the possibility of the IDF expanding the ground operation there as well. Leading media outlets flooded screens and front pages with images of starving children, trauma victims, and the destruction of homes and hospitals. Reports and personal stories from Rafah led to empathy toward the Palestinians’ suffering and anger toward Israel's military actions. "Although most media outlets refrained from blaming Israel for creating the crisis intentionally or denying its right to self-defense, opinion pieces sparked fierce debate regarding the proportionality and morality of the ongoing military operation in its current form. Critical voices that were once silenced now have a wider platform.    “Reports focused on the immense humanitarian damages and the harm to innocent civilians, which many analysts argue is unjustified and goes against the values of the IDF’s operation. Even publicists who supported Israel in the past admitted that the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy,” the report read. “Against this backdrop, a narrative is emerging among liberal authors, which sees the Biden administration and its policy of providing weapons and diplomatic support to Israel as responsible for the situation, or at least as someone who can bring it to an end." Furthermore, dozens of recent opinion pieces represent a wide range of positions regarding the IDF’s legitimacy, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, the question of a cease-fire, and the future of U.S.-Israel relations: Conservative media outlets like The Wall Street Journal and The New York Post fully support Israel, advocate for continued military action against Hamas, and refrain from calling for an immediate and prolonged stop to the war.  In contrast, newspapers identified with the center and liberal left, including The New York Times and The Washington Post, criticize the war’s escalation, citing the destructive consequences of the confrontation on Palestinian civilians, and therefore calling for an immediate humanitarian cease-fire, the reports explained.   The reports also expose an erosion of Israel's standing in Washington against the backdrop of the escalation in the Gaza war. This was clearly reflected in U.S. President Joe Biden's statement regarding a "red line" on military operations in Rafah, and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech.  Most analysts don’t foresee an immediate shift in relations between the countries, but caution against potential political damage to both sides. Furthermore, calls are increasing to use American military aid to Israel as leverage to force policy change in Jerusalem. However, warnings have been raised that the fact of having this discussion could bolster Hamas's position and undermine the chances of a cease-fire.  While conservative media outlets present Israel's policy as legitimate self-defense, liberal media outlets provide a platform for writers who echo the Palestinian narrative, sometimes using rhetoric accusing Israel of "apartheid" and even "genocide." Calls for the U.S. government to distance itself from supporting Israel and reconsider its military aid plan are becoming more common, even in moderate media outlets. The report mentions articles in The Washington Post and The Daily Beast highlighting the effectiveness of pro-Palestinian activists in influencing public opinion in the U.S., especially among progressive Democratic voters. The articles point to growing discontent with the Biden administration's support for Israel, reflected in "Uncommitted" votes in the Democratic primaries and disruptions at party events. Tactics such as demanding a cease-fire and using the term "genocide" have succeeded in keeping the war at the forefront of the national political agenda and increasing pressure on Washington to minimize its support of Israel.  The increasing willingness of Democratic politicians to criticize Israel suggests a shift in the party's traditional stance and leads to speech free of restraint in media outlets as well. This trend reached its zenith with Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech, in which he labeled Netanyahu an "obstacle to peace" and accused him of damaging Israel's international standing, calling for early Israeli elections.

news.originalContent: Rather than celebrating and resting over the three-day holiday, residents of the Jewish community of Hendon in north London and Radlett were struck by shock and grief after the deadly terror attack that took the lives of two daughters of their beloved and esteemed Rabbi Leo Dee, on Friday, the second day of Passover which is considered a holly day in diaspora communities.   Follow Ynetnews on Facebook and Twitter >> Related stories: Israel names two sisters killed in West Bank terror attack At least one dead and six injured in a terror attack in Tel Aviv Family loses two daughters to deadly terror attack Members of the Jewish London community, including friends of the family, who heard of the devastating news after the Shabbat ended, were confronted only then, with the horrific reports of Maia and Rina's death. The funerals for the Dee sisters will be held today at the Kfar Etzion Cemetery.   Rabbi Leo Dee served as the Assistant Rabbi at the Hendon United Synagogue in North London from 2008-2011, and as the Senior Rabbi at Radlett United Synagogue from 2011-2014, after which the family made aliyah. They were a much beloved and respected family in the UK Jewish community. “People feel shock and disappointment. The family were communal people and served their communities well and were well-liked.” said a former member of the congregation at Hendon United Synagogue who did not wish to be named.  “I feel sick seeing this… good people who would never hurt anyone, murdered. I can't imagine his anguish, and pray Lucy survives,” said Joseph, another former congregant.   Chief UK Rabbi Sir Ephraim Mirvis laments the death of the British-Israeli girls murdered in Friday's terror strike on the West Bank.  In a statement, the rabbi said: "No words can describe the depth of our shock and sadness at the heartbreaking news of the murder by terrorists in Israel of Maya & Rina Dee, daughters of Rebbetzen Lucy, who is in a critical condition & Rabbi Leo Dee, my dear colleagues. He continued, “They were much loved in the Hendon and Radlett communities in the UK, as well as in Israel and well beyond.” UK statement not mentioning terrorism The British Board of Deputies also issued a statement expressing shock over the tragic attack: “We are deeply shocked and saddened at the murder by Palestinian terrorists of Maia and Rina Dee, the daughters of Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee formerly of Radlett United Synagogue. We wish Lucy Refuah Shlemah and long life to the family as they cope with this devastating news.” Palestinian terrorist shot and killed 2 British-Israeli nationals, also critically injuring their mother in the West Bank. The victims were identified Saturday as 15-year-old Rina Dee and 20-year-old Maia Dee, the daughters of British-born Rabbi Leo Dee.  While their mother, Lucy (Lea), remains in critical condition fighting for her life, the Jewish community in the UK has expressed shock and sorrow at the brutal act of terrorism against former members of their community.    While many Jewish community leaders spoke out about the attack, the UK government has received criticism from some members of the community for its weakly-worded response to the killing of two of its own citizens.  One member of the Jewish community told Ynet that it was shocking that the UK statement didn’t even mention terrorism. “The response would be different if this happened elsewhere in the world. There is a double standard for British people killed in Israel,” he said.  The UK’s official statement read: “We are saddened to hear about the deaths of two British-Israeli citizens and the serious injuries sustained by a third individual. The UK calls for all parties across the region to de-escalate tensions.” "Tragedy for global Jewish community" Avi Abelow, family friend, said Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee are beloved and active members of their community in Efrat. "Two of the sweetest people with the sweetest children", he added. "Rabbi Leo continues to teach Torah classes in his Efrat synagogue today. All the youth of Efrat, as their families, are mourning the loss of either their personal friend or the sibling of their personal friend."  He mentioned that "Just last night the whole community got together, including many youth, for a special communal prayer gathering to pray for Lucy's recovery. The brutal Arab Muslim terrorist attack that murdered these two young, innocent Jewish women, and seriously injured their mother fighting for her life, is not just a tragedy for their family, but for the whole Efrat community and the global Jewish community.  "At the same time that another terrorist committed a terror attack in Tel Aviv, which killed an Italian tourist, and terrorist organizations are shooting rockets at Israel from Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, we are once again reminded that the Jewish people have enemies trying to kill us everywhere in our country for just being Jews living in our ancestral homeland.  "If only the UK government and other global bodies would recognize this truth, and truly give support to Israel to stop this ongoing terror war against Israel, which causes loss of life for everyone. In the meantime, as a personal friend and neighbor of the Dee family, my family, neighbors, and community will continue to assist and comfort the Dee family, as we assisted and comforted the family of our other friend and neighbor, Ari Fuld, murdered by terrorists back in 2018."

news.originalContent: Iran's powerful Revolutionary Guards warned anti-government protesters of "decisive" action if unrest over gasoline price hikes do not cease, state television reported on Monday. The warning appeared to hint at a looming crackdown on protests that flared nationwide in response to an official announcement on Friday of gasoline rationing and price hikes of at least 50 percent. "If necessary we will take decisive and revolutionary action against any continued moves to disturb the people's peace and security," the Guards said in a statement carried by state media.
news.content: تلویزیون دولتی روز دوشنبه گزارش داد که سپاه پاسداران قدرتمند ایران به معترضان ضد دولتی هشدار داد که اگر ناآرامی ها بر سر افزایش قیمت بنزین متوقف نشود، اقدام «قاطعانه» خواهند کرد. به نظر می‌رسد این هشدار به سرکوب اعتراض‌هایی که در سراسر کشور در واکنش به اعلام رسمی روز جمعه مبنی بر سهمیه‌بندی بنزین و افزایش حداقل 50 درصدی قیمت‌ها شعله‌ور شد، اشاره می‌کند. سپاه پاسداران در بیانیه‌ای که توسط رسانه‌های دولتی منتشر شد، گفت: «در صورت لزوم، در برابر هرگونه اقدام مستمر برای برهم زدن آرامش و امنیت مردم، اقدام قاطع و انقلابی خواهیم کرد».
